translation: adj. 听的，听觉的
original_sentence: Different learning styles Auditory Visual Physical Auditory learners learn best when information is presented in a verbal manner such as when the teacher talks to the class.

wordForms.noun: audition n. 试镜，试演；audience n. 听众，观众；auditorium n. 礼堂，音乐厅
wordForms.other: 构词法：词根 aud-/audit- = hear（听）→ audio 音频的、audible 听得见的（反义 inaudible）、audience 听众、audition 试演、auditorium 礼堂；auditory 一般只作定语（auditory organs 听觉器官），不作表语；重音在第一音节 /ˈɔːdətri/

collocations.translation: 听觉型学习者（课文原句）
collocations.example: Auditory learners learn best when information is presented in a verbal manner. 听觉型学习者在信息以口头方式呈现时学得最好。
My auditory learning style helps me remember lectures. 我的听觉型学习风格帮我记住讲座内容。
Loud noise can damage the auditory nerve. 巨大的噪音会损伤听觉神经。
Songs help train children's auditory memory. 歌曲有助于训练儿童的听觉记忆。

synonyms.example: The concert hall has excellent acoustic effects. 这座音乐厅音效极佳。
synonyms.usage: acoustic 指'声音的/声学的'，描述声音本身或环境（acoustic guitar 原声吉他）；auditory 指'听觉的'，与耳朵和听觉器官、听觉过程相关（auditory nerve 听觉神经）。两者都主要作定语。

advancedExpressions.expression: aud-/audit- = hear：audio / audible→inaudible / audience / audition / auditorium / auditory
advancedExpressions.example: The teacher's voice was barely audible at the back of the hall. 老师的声音在大厅后排几乎听不见。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·学习风格（本单元 Welcome）
advancedExpressions.expression: auditory 听觉型 / visual 视觉型 / physical 动觉型 + learners/learning style
advancedExpressions.example: Visual learners prefer pictures while auditory learners prefer spoken explanations. 视觉型学习者偏爱图片，听觉型学习者偏爱口头讲解。

classPractice.question: 用 auditory / visual 填空：______ learners learn best by listening to the teacher's explanations.
classPractice.note: 由 by listening 可知是听觉型学习者，对应课文 Welcome to the unit 三种学习风格。

classPractice.question: The music was hardly ______ (audit) above the noise of the traffic.
classPractice.note: aud-词根家族：此处指'能被听见的'用 audible；auditory 只表'听觉（器官）的'，且一般不作表语。

classPractice.question: 听觉型学习者通过听录音学得最好。
classPractice.answer: Auditory learners learn best by listening to recordings.
classPractice.note: learn best by doing 通过……学得最好。

translation: adj. 口头的；言语的，文字的
original_sentence: Different learning styles Auditory Visual Physical Auditory learners learn best when information is presented in a verbal manner such as when the teacher talks to the class.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 动词的（语法术语，熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: A verbal noun is a noun formed from a verb. 动名词是由动词构成的名词。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 口头的（与书面 written 相对）
uncommonMeanings.example: We had only a verbal agreement, nothing in writing. 我们只有口头约定，没有任何书面文件。

wordForms.verb: verbalize v. 用言语表达
wordForms.adverb: verbally adv. 口头上，用言语地
wordForms.other: 构词法：词根 verb- = word（词语）→ verb 动词、adverb 副词、proverb 谚语、verbatim 逐字地；反义：non-verbal 非言语的

collocations.translation: 以口头的方式（课文原句）
collocations.example: Auditory learners learn best when information is presented in a verbal manner. 信息以口头方式呈现时，听觉型学习者学得最好。
They made a verbal agreement to share the profits. 他们达成口头协议分享利润。

collocations.translation: 言语交流/语言表达能力
collocations.example: Good verbal skills are essential for a teacher. 良好的语言表达能力对教师至关重要。

collocations.translation: 非言语交流（肢体、表情等）
collocations.example: Body language is a form of non-verbal communication. 肢体语言是一种非言语交流。

synonyms.example: We will have an oral exam next week. 下周我们有一场口试。
synonyms.usage: oral 强调'用嘴说的'，与 written 相对，固定搭配 oral exam/test 口试；verbal 既可指'口头的'（verbal promise），也泛指'用语言（而非动作、图像）表达的'（verbal skills）。两者都以作定语为主。

synonyms.example: Her spoken English is better than her written English. 她的英语口语比笔头好。
synonyms.usage: spoken 修饰语言本身（spoken English 口语）；verbal 修饰信息传递的方式（verbal instructions 口头指示）。

advancedExpressions.expression: verb- = word：verb 动词 / adverb 副词 / proverb 谚语 / verbal / verbally / verbatim 逐字地
advancedExpressions.example: As the proverb goes, one is never too old to learn. 正如谚语所说，活到老学到老。

advancedExpressions.expression: a verbal/oral agreement ↔ a written contract；in words ↔ in writing
advancedExpressions.example: A verbal offer is not as safe as a written contract. 口头承诺不如书面合同可靠。

classPractice.question: 用 verbal / oral 填空：I will take an ______ exam in English; the teacher gave us ______ instructions instead of written ones.
classPractice.note: 口试固定说 oral exam/test；'口头（非书面）指示'常用 verbal instructions。

classPractice.question: The two sides reached the agreement ______ (verbal), without signing any papers.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 reached 用副词 verbally '以口头方式'。

classPractice.question: 信息以口头方式呈现时，听觉型学习者学得最好。
classPractice.answer: Auditory learners learn best when information is presented in a verbal manner.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译：in a verbal manner 以口头方式；when 引导时间状语从句。

translation: adj. & n. adj. 空白的 n. 空白处，空格
original_sentence: When I drew a still life, it was impressed upon me that the blank spaces between the objects were just as vital to the success of the composition as the actual objects themselves.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （课件·熟词僻义）突然忘记，大脑一片空白
uncommonMeanings.example: I just blanked in the oral exam. 口试时我大脑突然一片空白。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （课件·英式口语）故意无视，不理睬（某人）
uncommonMeanings.example: I saw her this morning, but she totally blanked me. 今早我看见她了，但她完全无视我。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 茫然的，无表情的
uncommonMeanings.example: He gave me a blank look when I mentioned the plan. 我提到那个计划时，他一脸茫然。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 断然的，完全的（作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: My request was met with a blank refusal. 我的请求遭到断然拒绝。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 空包弹（常用复数 blanks）
uncommonMeanings.example: The soldiers were firing blanks in the drill. 演习中士兵们打的是空包弹。

wordForms.adverb: blankly adv. 茫然地，面无表情地
wordForms.other: blank 兼作 adj./n./v.，注意语境判断词性；课件例句：She stared blankly into space, not knowing what to say next. 她茫然地凝视着前方，不知接下来说什么。

idioms.example: I tried to remember her name but drew a blank. 我想记起她的名字，却怎么也想不起来。

idioms.translation: 空白支票；（喻）全权，自由处理权
idioms.example: The manager was given a blank cheque to reform the team. 经理获得全权去改组球队。

collocations.phrase: the blank spaces between the objects
collocations.translation: 物体之间的空白处（课文原句）
collocations.example: The blank spaces between the objects were just as vital as the objects themselves. 物体之间的空白与物体本身同样重要。
Fill in the blanks with the proper forms of the words. 用单词的适当形式填空。
If you can't answer the question, leave a blank. 如果你答不出这个问题，就空着。
My mind suddenly went blank. 我的脑子突然一片空白。

collocations.phrase: with a blank expression / look blank
collocations.example: She looked at me with a blank expression. 她面无表情地看着我。
He stared at the blank page, not knowing how to begin. 他盯着空白的纸页，不知如何下笔。

advancedExpressions.expression: fill in the blanks 填空 / leave a blank 留空 / one's mind goes blank 大脑空白 / look blank 一脸茫然 / draw a blank 一无所获 / blank sb 无视某人
advancedExpressions.example: When the teacher called my name, my mind went blank. 老师叫到我名字时，我大脑一片空白。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（并列+主从复合）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句＝When 时间状语从句 + it 形式主语 + that 真正主语从句，从句内含 just as...as... 同级比较：When I drew a still life, it was impressed upon me that the blank spaces ... were just as vital to ... as the actual objects themselves.
advancedExpressions.example: impress sth upon/on sb 使某人铭记（课件讲点），被动式 it was impressed upon me that... 我深深意识到……

classPractice.question: 我的脑子突然一片空白。My mind suddenly ______ ______.
classPractice.note: go blank（大脑）变得一片空白；go + adj. 表状态变化，句子为过去时故用 went。

classPractice.question: She stared ______ (blank) into space, not knowing what to say next.
classPractice.note: 改编自课件例句：修饰动词 stared 用副词 blankly '茫然地'。

classPractice.question: 如果你答不出这个问题，就留空白。
classPractice.answer: If you can't answer the question, leave a blank.
classPractice.note: 课件原句：leave a blank 留空不填，blank 作名词'空白处'。

classPractice.question: 用 blank / blankly 填空：He looked ______ at the ______ page, and then his mind went ______.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 looked 用副词 blankly；修饰名词 page 用形容词 blank '空白的'；go blank 中 blank 作表语形容词。

translation: n. 构图；构成，成分；作品；作曲艺术
original_sentence: When I drew a still life, it was impressed upon me that the blank spaces between the objects were just as vital to the success of the composition as the actual objects themselves.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 构图（绘画、摄影的布局，课文义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Good composition makes a photo pleasing to the eye. 好的构图使照片赏心悦目。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 构成，成分
uncommonMeanings.example: The composition of the committee has changed. 委员会的组成已经变了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 作文；写作
uncommonMeanings.example: She got full marks for her English composition. 她的英语作文得了满分。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （音乐、诗歌等）作品；作曲（艺术）
uncommonMeanings.example: He studied composition at the music academy. 他在音乐学院学习作曲。

wordForms.verb: compose v. 组成；创作（乐曲、诗歌）；使镇静（compose oneself 使自己镇定下来）
wordForms.noun: composer n. 作曲家；composition n. 构图；成分；作文；作品
wordForms.adjective: composed adj. 镇静的，沉着的
wordForms.other: 构词法：com-（一起）+ pos（放）→ '放到一起'＝组成、创作；同根词 position 位置、expose 暴露、propose 提议、oppose 反对

collocations.example: The blank spaces were just as vital to the success of the composition as the objects. 空白处对构图的成功与实物同样重要。
We were asked to write a composition about lifelong learning. 我们被要求写一篇关于终身学习的作文。
Scientists studied the composition of the soil. 科学家们研究了土壤的成分。
This musical composition was written for the piano. 这部音乐作品是为钢琴而作的。

synonyms.example: Write an essay on the given topic. 就所给话题写一篇短文。
synonyms.usage: essay 是考试作文（尤指议论文）的标准说法；composition 更传统，泛指学生习作，另有'构图、成分、音乐作品'等义，义项更广。

synonyms.example: They analysed the genetic make-up of the virus. 他们分析了病毒的基因构成。
synonyms.usage: make-up 较口语（另有'化妆品'义）；composition 更正式，指整体由哪些部分构成，常接 of sth。

advancedExpressions.expression: be composed of = consist of = be made up of = comprise
advancedExpressions.example: The class is composed of thirty students. 这个班由三十名学生组成。

advancedExpressions.expression: pos(e) = put：compose 组成 / expose 暴露 / propose 提议 / oppose 反对 / position 位置
advancedExpressions.example: He proposed a new plan at the meeting. 他在会上提出了一个新计划。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（并列+主从复合）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句主干：it（形式主语）+ was impressed upon me + that 真正主语从句；从句内 just as vital to...as... 同级比较
advancedExpressions.example: It was impressed upon me that the blank spaces were just as vital to the composition as the objects. 我深深体会到空白处对构图与实物同样重要。

classPractice.question: The orchestra played a piece ______ (compose) by a young musician.
classPractice.note: a piece 与 compose 是被动关系，用过去分词短语作后置定语。

classPractice.question: 用 compose / composer / composition 的适当形式填空：Beethoven was a great ______ whose ______ are still played today.
classPractice.note: -er/-or 表'人'→作曲家；compositions '作品'可数，由 are 判断用复数。

classPractice.question: 这个委员会由十名成员组成。
classPractice.answer: The committee is composed of ten members.
classPractice.note: be composed of = consist of（consist 不用被动）= be made up of。

translation: n. 教育家；教育工作者

wordForms.verb: educate v. 教育，培养
wordForms.noun: education n. 教育；educator n. 教育家，教育工作者
wordForms.adjective: educational adj. 教育的，有教育意义的；educated adj. 受过教育的（well-educated 受过良好教育的）
wordForms.other: 构词法：-or 后缀表'……的人'：educator 教育家、instructor 教员、inventor 发明家、visitor 参观者；重音在第一音节 /ˈedʒukeɪtə(r)/

collocations.example: Confucius is regarded as a great educator in Chinese history. 孔子被视为中国历史上伟大的教育家。
Schools should educate students about online safety. 学校应就网络安全教育学生。
Every child has the right to receive a good education. 每个孩子都有权接受良好的教育。

collocations.translation: 高等教育/继续教育/成人教育
collocations.example: More and more adults are returning to higher education. 越来越多的成年人重返高等教育（呼应单元主题终身学习）。

synonyms.example: My English teacher encourages us to read widely. 我的英语老师鼓励我们广泛阅读。
synonyms.usage: teacher 指具体从事课堂教学的老师，日常用词；educator 更正式，泛指教育工作者，也特指有教育思想、有影响的'教育家'（a respected educator）。

advancedExpressions.expression: educate→educator；instruct→instructor；invent→inventor；translate→translator
advancedExpressions.example: The educator devoted his life to rural schools. 这位教育家把一生献给了乡村学校。

advancedExpressions.expression: receive/get an education 接受教育 / higher/further/adult education / educational resources 教育资源
advancedExpressions.example: Adult education makes lifelong learning possible. 成人教育使终身学习成为可能。

classPractice.question: Tao Xingzhi was a great ______ (educate) who devoted himself to rural education.
classPractice.note: a great 后接指人名词，用 educator '教育家'；who 引导定语从句。

classPractice.question: The museum is both interesting and ______ (educate) for children.
classPractice.note: 与形容词 interesting 并列，故用形容词 educational '有教育意义的'。

classPractice.question: 孔子是中国古代伟大的教育家和思想家。
classPractice.answer: Confucius was a great educator and thinker in ancient China.
classPractice.note: educator 教育家；and 并列两个指人名词。

translation: n. 孔子

wordForms.noun: Confucius n. 孔子（专有名词，首字母大写）；Confucianism n. 儒家思想，儒学
wordForms.adjective: Confucian adj. 孔子的，儒家的（Confucian classics 儒家经典）
wordForms.other: 发音 /kənˈfjuːʃəs/ 重音在第二音节；专有名词无复数；表所属可用 Confucius's 或形容词 Confucian

idioms.idiom: One is never too old to learn.
idioms.translation: 活到老，学到老（单元标题 Never too old to learn 即源于此谚语）
idioms.example: Grandpa began learning painting at 70—one is never too old to learn. 爷爷七十岁开始学画——活到老学到老。

collocations.example: The Analects of Confucius records the master's sayings. 《论语》记录了孔子的言论。

collocations.translation: 正如孔子所说……（写作引用句式）
collocations.example: As Confucius said, learning without thought is labour lost. 正如孔子所说，学而不思则罔。
The thoughts of Confucius still influence education today. 孔子的思想至今仍影响着教育。

advancedExpressions.type: 功能表达集合·引用名言（写作加分句式）
advancedExpressions.expression: As Confucius said, ... / As an old saying goes, ... / There is a famous saying that ...
advancedExpressions.example: As Confucius said, isn't it a pleasure to learn and practise what is learned? 正如孔子所说：学而时习之，不亦说乎？

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·终身学习（单元主题）
advancedExpressions.expression: lifelong learning 终身学习 / never cease to learn 永不停止学习 / One is never too old to learn. 活到老学到老
advancedExpressions.example: One should never cease to learn. 人不能停止学习。

classPractice.question: 孔子被认为是中国最伟大的教育家之一。
classPractice.answer: Confucius is considered (to be) one of the greatest educators in China.
classPractice.note: be considered (to be)... 被认为是；one of + 最高级 + 复数名词。

classPractice.question: ______ (Confucius) thoughts on learning have influenced China for over 2,000 years.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 thoughts 用形容词 Confucian '儒家的'（也可用所有格 Confucius's）。

classPractice.question: 正如孔子所说，学习永远不嫌晚。As ______ ______, one is never too old to learn.
classPractice.note: as sb said 正如某人所说，引用名言的常用写作句式，呼应单元标题 Never too old to learn。

translation: adj. 一定会，很可能会；有义务（做某事）
original_sentence: Furthermore, the production of knowledge is bound to grow rapidly.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 跳跃着跑，蹦跳（课件）
uncommonMeanings.example: She bounded to her feet and waved her right hand happily. 她跳了起来，高兴地挥动着右手。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 跳跃（课件）
uncommonMeanings.example: With one bound the deer disappeared in the thick woods. 鹿一跳就消失在密林里了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: bind（捆绑；使受约束）的过去式和过去分词
uncommonMeanings.example: The nurse bound the wound with a clean bandage. 护士用干净的绷带包扎了伤口。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数 bounds）界限，限度
uncommonMeanings.example: Her enthusiasm for learning knows no bounds. 她的学习热情没有止境。

wordForms.noun: bound 跳跃；bounds 界限；boundary 边界，分界线
wordForms.verb: bind (bound, bound) 捆绑；约束；bound 跳跃
wordForms.adjective: bound 一定会的；有义务的；boundless 无边无际的
wordForms.other: 构词贴士：-bound 可构成复合形容词，如 homeward-bound commuters 回家的通勤者、Paris-bound plane 飞往巴黎的航班（课件）、snowbound 被雪困住的；注意区分：bound 既是独立形容词，又是 bind 的过去（分词）式，靠语境判断。

idioms.example: Her generosity knows no bounds. 她的慷慨没有止境。
The lab is out of bounds to visitors. 实验室禁止参观者进入。
His English has improved by leaps and bounds. 他的英语突飞猛进。

collocations.translation: 必然会快速增长（课文原句）
collocations.example: The production of knowledge is bound to grow rapidly. 知识的生产必然会快速增长。
The earth's climate is bound to change greatly in the future. 地球的气候在未来必然会有很大的变化。
There are bound to be changes when the new system is introduced. 新制度实行时肯定会有变化。
You are bound by the contract to pay before the end of the month. 按合同你必须在月底前付款。

collocations.phrase: be bound by custom/tradition to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】按照风俗/传统必须做某事
collocations.example: We are bound by tradition to take part in the ceremony. 按照传统我们必须参加典礼。
The ship is bound for South America. 这艘船开往南美洲。

collocations.translation: 【课件】与……密切相关（be closely connected with）
collocations.example: The driver is bound up with the terrible accident. 那名司机与这起可怕的事故密切相关。
I do not feel bound to give you everything you want. 我没有义务满足你的一切要求。

synonyms.example: He is sure to pass the exam. 他肯定能通过考试。
synonyms.usage: be bound to 依据情理、趋势推断'必然会'，主语可为人或物（气候、变化等）；be sure to 多表说话人主观有把握；两者都接动词原形，作表语结构。

synonyms.example: Prices are certain to rise this year. 今年物价必然上涨。
synonyms.usage: be certain to 与 be bound to 意思最接近，均可用于 it/there 句型：There are bound/certain to be problems.

synonyms.example: It is likely to rain tonight. 今晚很可能下雨。
synonyms.usage: be likely to 只表'可能性大'，把握程度低于 be bound to；它还可用于 It is likely that... 句型，而 bound 无此用法。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·bound 一词四搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: be bound to do 一定会 / be bound by 受……约束 / be bound for 开往…… / be bound up with 与……密切相关
advancedExpressions.example: The train bound for Beijing is bound to arrive on time. 开往北京的火车一定会准点到达。

advancedExpressions.expression: be bound to do = be sure/certain to do = will definitely do
advancedExpressions.example: Lifelong learners are bound to keep pace with the times. 终身学习者必然能跟上时代。

advancedExpressions.type: 常用结构·There be 句型
advancedExpressions.expression: There is/are bound to be + n. 肯定会有……（bound 后接原形 be）
advancedExpressions.example: There are bound to be difficulties on the road to success. 成功路上必然会有困难。

advancedExpressions.expression: 方向词/名词 + -bound：homeward-bound 归家的、Paris-bound 飞往巴黎的、snowbound 被雪困的
advancedExpressions.example: The station was crowded with homeward-bound commuters. 车站挤满了回家的通勤者。

classPractice.question: There ______________________ (一定会有变化) when the new system is introduced.
classPractice.note: There be 句型与 be bound to 套叠：There + be + bound to be + n.；bound 后接动词原形 be。

classPractice.question: The flight has taken off at 8:01 from Nanjing ____________ (飞往) Wuhan.
classPractice.note: bound for + 地点'开往/飞往……'，此处形容词短语作后置定语。

classPractice.question: I ___________________ (没有义务) give you everything you want.
classPractice.note: feel bound to do sth 感到有义务做某事；否定加在 feel 上。

classPractice.question: The earth's climate is bound ______ (change) greatly in the future.
classPractice.note: be bound to do sth，bound 后接不定式。

translation: 一定会，很可能会

collocations.translation: 必然会快速增长（课文原句）
collocations.example: Furthermore, the production of knowledge is bound to grow rapidly. 而且，知识的生产必然会快速增长。
The earth's climate is bound to change greatly in the future. 地球的气候在未来必然会有很大的变化。
It's bound to be sunny again tomorrow. 明天肯定又是阳光灿烂。
There are bound to be changes when the new system is introduced. 新制度实行时肯定会有变化。
I do not feel bound to give you everything you want. 我没有义务满足你的一切要求。

synonyms.example: Work hard and you are sure to succeed. 努力干，你肯定会成功。
synonyms.usage: be bound to 依据情理趋势推断，主语可为人或物；be sure to 偏说话人主观把握；祈使句后接 and you are sure/bound to... 都常见。

synonyms.example: The plan is certain to work. 这个计划必然奏效。
synonyms.usage: 与 be bound to 可互换；certain 另有 It is certain that... 句型，bound 没有。

synonyms.example: They were destined to meet again. 他们注定会重逢。
synonyms.usage: be destined to 强调'命运注定'，文学色彩浓；be bound to 强调'按情理必然'。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·必然/肯定会
advancedExpressions.expression: be bound to do = be sure/certain to do = will surely/definitely do；'命中注定'用 be destined to do
advancedExpressions.example: Those who never stop learning are bound to succeed. 从不停止学习的人必然会成功。

advancedExpressions.expression: be bound to do 一定会 / be bound by 受……约束 / be bound for 开往 / be bound up with 与……密切相关
advancedExpressions.example: Our future is bound up with the habit of lifelong learning. 我们的未来与终身学习的习惯息息相关。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（并列+主从复合）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文句以 Furthermore 衔接上文构成递进并列关系，主句为简单的'主+系表(be bound to do)'结构
advancedExpressions.example: Furthermore, the production of knowledge is bound to grow rapidly. Furthermore 是承上启下的递进连接副词。

classPractice.question: 地球的气候在未来必然会有很大的变化。
classPractice.answer: The earth's climate is bound to change greatly in the future.
classPractice.note: be bound to do sth 一定会，必然会。

classPractice.question: 明天肯定又是阳光灿烂。
classPractice.answer: It's bound to be sunny again tomorrow.
classPractice.note: it 作主语谈天气，be bound to be + adj.。

classPractice.question: I ___________________ (没有义务) give you everything you want.
classPractice.note: feel bound to do sth 感到有义务做某事。

translation: 与…步调一致，与…并驾齐驱

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一步；步幅
uncommonMeanings.example: He took two paces forward and stopped. 他向前迈了两步就停下了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （发展、变化的）速度，节奏
uncommonMeanings.example: The pace of change in technology is amazing. 科技变化的速度惊人。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 踱步；（焦虑地）走来走去
uncommonMeanings.example: She paced the floor, waiting for the news. 她来回踱步，等着消息。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: pace oneself 为自己掌握好节奏
uncommonMeanings.example: Pace yourself, or you'll burn out before the exam. 掌握好节奏，否则考前你就精疲力竭了。

wordForms.noun: pace 步伐；速度，节奏
wordForms.verb: pace 踱步；pace oneself 调节节奏
wordForms.adjective: fast-paced 节奏快的；slow-paced 节奏慢的
wordForms.other: 拓展：pacemaker 领跑者；心脏起搏器；构词贴士：形容词常用'速度词+-paced'复合，如 a fast-paced life 快节奏的生活。

idioms.translation: 以蜗牛般的速度，极慢地
idioms.example: Traffic moved at a snail's pace. 车流缓慢地移动。

collocations.example: Wage increases have always kept pace with social development. 工资的增长总是与社会发展保持同步。
We must keep learning to keep pace with the times. 我们必须不断学习以跟上时代。
The captain set the pace for most of the course in this year's marathon. 在今年马拉松的大部分赛程中队长都在领跑。
Online courses let students learn at their own pace. 网课让学生按自己的节奏学习。
Hearing the bell, he quickened his pace. 听到铃声，他加快了脚步。
The small town enjoys a relaxed pace of life. 这座小镇生活节奏轻松。

collocations.phrase: pace up and down / pace the floor
collocations.example: She paced up and down outside the room. 她在房间外来回踱步。
He'll have to learn to pace himself in this job. 他必须学会使自己适应这项工作的节奏。

synonyms.example: I can't keep up with the changes in fashion. 我跟不上时尚的变化。
synonyms.usage: keep up with 较口语，宾语可为人、潮流、进度；keep pace with 强调'与……同速前进'，常接 development/change/times 等抽象名词。

synonyms.example: Read widely to keep abreast of the latest developments. 广泛阅读以了解最新动态。
synonyms.usage: keep abreast of 侧重'掌握最新信息'，宾语多为 news/developments/changes，不接人；keep pace with 可接人或物。

advancedExpressions.expression: keep pace with 与……同步 / set the pace 领跑 / at one's own pace 按自己的节奏 / quicken one's pace 加快脚步 / pace up and down 来回踱步 / pace oneself 调节节奏
advancedExpressions.example: To keep pace with others, don't forget to pace yourself. 想跟上别人，别忘了调整好自己的节奏。

advancedExpressions.expression: keep pace with = keep up with；'及时知悉信息'用 keep abreast of
advancedExpressions.example: Lifelong learning helps us keep pace with the fast-changing world. 终身学习帮助我们跟上瞬息万变的世界。

classPractice.question: 工资的增长总是与社会发展保持同步。
classPractice.answer: Wage increases have always kept pace with social development.
classPractice.note: keep pace with sth 与……保持同步；注意 keep-kept。

classPractice.question: We must never stop learning to keep ______ ______ the rapid development of technology.（跟上）
classPractice.note: keep pace with 与……并驾齐驱；不定式短语作目的状语。

classPractice.question: He'll have to learn to ______ himself in this job.（调整节奏）
classPractice.note: pace oneself 使自己掌握好节奏（课件例句）。

translation: vt. & vi. & n. vt. & vi. 解决；表决；决心，决定 n. 决心，坚定的信念
original_sentence: Indeed, you may one day do jobs that do not yet exist, use technologies that are not yet developed and resolve problems that are not yet problems!

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （会议等经表决）正式决定，表决（课件）
uncommonMeanings.example: The Senate resolved to accept his proposal. 参议院表决接受他的提议。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 决心，坚定的信念（= resolution）（课件）
uncommonMeanings.example: Nothing could weaken his resolve to learn English well. 什么也动摇不了他学好英语的决心。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）逐渐变成，分解为（resolve into）
uncommonMeanings.example: The discussion soon resolved itself into two debates. 讨论很快变成了两场辩论。

wordForms.noun: resolution 决心；决议；解决；resolve 决心，坚定的信念
wordForms.verb: resolve 解决；决心；表决
wordForms.adjective: resolute 坚决的；resolved 下定决心的（作表语：be resolved to do）；unresolved 未解决的
wordForms.other: 构词法：re-（加强）+ solve（解开）→'解开'难题即'解决'，'解开'犹豫即'下定决心'；重音在第二音节 /rɪˈzɒlv/。

collocations.phrase: resolve problems that are not yet problems
collocations.translation: 解决尚未成为问题的问题（课文原句）
collocations.example: You may one day resolve problems that are not yet problems! 有一天你可能要解决现在还不是问题的问题！
The two sides met to resolve the dispute. 双方会面以解决争端。

collocations.phrase: resolve to do sth / resolve that...
collocations.example: He resolved not to tell her the truth. 他决心不告诉她真相。
We had resolved on making an early start. 我们已决定一早出发。

collocations.phrase: make a resolution/a resolve to do sth
collocations.example: Have you made any New Year's resolutions? 你许下什么新年决心了吗？
The committee passed a resolution to cut costs. 委员会通过了一项削减成本的决议。
The difficulties in her way merely strengthened her resolve. 路上的困难只是坚定了她的决心。

synonyms.example: She solved the math problem in a minute. 她一分钟就解出了那道数学题。
synonyms.usage: solve 及物，宾语多为 problem/puzzle/mystery，重在'找到答案'；resolve 更正式，宾语多为 dispute/conflict/crisis/difference，重在'消除分歧使了结'，还有'决心、表决'义。

synonyms.example: They settled the argument peacefully. 他们和平地了结了争论。
synonyms.usage: settle 强调使争端平息、达成一致，常与 dispute/argument/matter 搭配；句法上三者都是及物动词。

synonyms.example: She is determined to go to a top university. 她决心考上顶尖大学。
synonyms.usage: resolve to do = be determined to do = make up one's mind to do；resolve 后还可接 that 从句：She resolved (that) she would never see him again.（课件）

advancedExpressions.expression: resolve a dispute/conflict/problem 解决 / resolve to do (that...) 决心 / resolve on (doing) 决定 / make a resolution(resolve) to do 下决心 / pass a resolution 通过决议 / strengthen one's resolve 坚定决心
advancedExpressions.example: He resolved on a plan and nothing could shake his resolve. 他定下计划，决心不可动摇。

advancedExpressions.expression: resolve to do = be determined to do = make up one's mind to do = make a resolution to do
advancedExpressions.example: I have resolved to read one book every month. 我已决心每月读一本书。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（并列+主从复合）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句：may 后接三个并列谓语 do jobs..., use technologies... and resolve problems...（A, B and C 并列），三个宾语各带一个 that 引导的定语从句
advancedExpressions.example: You may one day do jobs that do not yet exist, use technologies that are not yet developed and resolve problems that are not yet problems!

classPractice.question: The director _______________________ (已经决定了一项计划) to save the film.
classPractice.note: resolve on sth 决定某事；此处用现在完成时。

classPractice.question: He __________________ (决心) go on a journey early in the next morning.
classPractice.note: make a resolve to do sth = resolve to do sth 下决心做某事。

classPractice.question: With the problems ______ (resolve), the company managed to bounce back.
classPractice.note: with + 宾语 + 过去分词：问题'被解决'，用过去分词 resolved。

classPractice.question: 双方开会解决了这场冲突。
classPractice.answer: The two sides held a meeting and resolved the conflict.
classPractice.note: resolve a conflict 解决冲突（课件核心搭配）。

translation: vt. 使更新；使恢复精力；使想起

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （计算机）刷新（页面、屏幕）
uncommonMeanings.example: Click this button to refresh the screen. 点这个按钮刷新屏幕。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使想起，提醒（refresh one's memory）
uncommonMeanings.example: This photo refreshed my memory of our school days. 这张照片让我想起了我们的学生时代。

wordForms.noun: refreshment 恢复精力；（refreshments）茶点，饮料
wordForms.verb: refresh 使恢复精力；使更新；使想起
wordForms.adjective: refreshing 提神的；令人耳目一新的（修饰事物）；refreshed 恢复了精神的（描述人）
wordForms.other: 构词法：re-（再）+ fresh（新鲜）→ 使重新有精神/更新；拓展：refresher course 进修课程；-ing/-ed 规律：a refreshing drink 提神的饮料 vs feel refreshed 感到神清气爽。

collocations.example: The long sleep had refreshed her. 长时间的睡眠使她精神焕发。
He had to refresh his memory by looking at his notes. 他不得不通过查看笔记来提醒自己。
He refreshed himself with a cold shower, then went back to work. 他冲了个冷水澡提提神，然后回去工作。
Many adults return to college to refresh their knowledge. 许多成年人重返大学更新知识。
Refresh the page to see the latest results. 刷新页面查看最新结果。

synonyms.example: I need to renew my library card. 我需要给借书证续期。
synonyms.usage: renew 指'使重新有效/重新开始'（renew a contract/licence 续约）；refresh 指'使恢复精力、唤起记忆、刷新'；两者都是及物动词。

synonyms.example: Please update the software to the latest version. 请把软件更新到最新版本。
synonyms.usage: update 强调'把信息/系统更新到最新状态'（update a database）；refresh one's knowledge 则指温习并补充已有知识。

synonyms.example: A cup of coffee revived him. 一杯咖啡使他恢复了活力。
synonyms.usage: revive 语气更强，指从衰弱/昏迷中'复苏'，也可指复兴传统；refresh 指日常性的'解乏提神'。

advancedExpressions.expression: refresh sb 使恢复精力 / refresh oneself with 用……提神 / refresh one's memory 唤起记忆 / refresh the page 刷新页面 / refresher course 进修课程
advancedExpressions.example: Before the exam, take a refresher course to refresh your memory. 考前上进修课温习一下。

advancedExpressions.expression: refresh oneself = freshen up = recharge one's batteries 充电，恢复精力
advancedExpressions.example: A short break helps you recharge your batteries. 短暂的休息能帮你恢复精力。

advancedExpressions.expression: re-（再，重新）：refresh 使更新 / renew 更新 / review 复习 / rebuild 重建 / resolve 中 re- 表加强
advancedExpressions.example: Lifelong learners keep refreshing and renewing what they know. 终身学习者不断更新自己的知识。

classPractice.question: He __________ __________ ________ (用……使自己恢复精神) a cold shower, then went back to work.
classPractice.note: refresh oneself with sth 用某物使自己恢复精神；反身代词 himself。

classPractice.question: 他不得不通过查看笔记来提醒自己。
classPractice.answer: He had to refresh his memory by looking at his notes.
classPractice.note: refresh one's memory 唤起记忆；by doing 表方式。

classPractice.question: A cup of tea is really ______ (refresh) after a long walk.
classPractice.note: -ing 形容词修饰事物'令人提神的'；-ed 形容词描述人的感受。

translation: adj. & n. adj. 客观的；客观存在的；宾格的 n. 目标，目的
original_sentence: Be objective and make yourself open to new knowledge and ideas.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 客观存在的，基于事实的
uncommonMeanings.example: There is no objective evidence to support the theory. 没有客观证据支持这一理论。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （语法）宾格的
uncommonMeanings.example: "Me" is the objective form of "I". me 是 I 的宾格形式。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （军事）目标
uncommonMeanings.example: The army finally achieved its military objective. 部队最终达成了军事目标。

wordForms.noun: objective 目标；objectivity 客观性（课件）；object 物体；目标；宾语；objection 反对
wordForms.verb: object (to sth/doing) 反对
wordForms.adjective: objective 客观的（反义 subjective 主观的，课件）
wordForms.other: 发音重音贴士：object 名词 /ˈɒbdʒɪkt/ 重音在前，动词 /əbˈdʒekt/ 重音在后；objective /əbˈdʒektɪv/ 重音在第二音节。

collocations.phrase: be objective and open to new knowledge and ideas
collocations.translation: 保持客观并接纳新知识新观念（课文原句）
collocations.example: Be objective and make yourself open to new knowledge and ideas. 要客观，并让自己接受新知识和新观念。
We worked hard to achieve our objectives. 我们努力工作以实现目标。
The main objective of the meeting is to give more information. 会议的主要目标是提供更多信息。
Set realistic aims and objectives for yourself. 为自己设定切合实际的目标。
We should be objective to others' criticism. 我们应客观对待别人的批评。
The expert made an objective analysis on this report. 那位专家就这份报告作了客观的分析。

synonyms.example: We need an unbiased report of the event. 我们需要一份对该事件不偏不倚的报道。
synonyms.usage: 课件：syn—unbiased, unprejudiced；opp—subjective。unbiased 强调'不偏袒任何一方'（报道、评委）；objective 强调'依据事实、不掺个人情感'；都作定语或表语。

synonyms.example: Try to look at it with an unprejudiced eye. 尽量以无成见的眼光看待此事。
synonyms.usage: unprejudiced 强调'没有先入为主的偏见'；语域较正式，多作定语。

synonyms.example: My goal is to enter a key university. 我的目标是考入重点大学。
synonyms.usage: objective 正式，指具体可衡量的目标（工作/会议/军事）；goal 指长远努力的目标；aim 侧重意图；target 指定额指标或攻击靶子。

advancedExpressions.expression: objective = unbiased = unprejudiced；反义词 subjective 主观的（课件）
advancedExpressions.example: Try to stay objective and unbiased when judging others. 评判他人时尽量保持客观、不带偏见。

advancedExpressions.expression: meet/achieve one's objective 实现目标 / the main(primary/principal) objective 首要目标 / set aims and objectives 设定目标 / an objective analysis 客观分析
advancedExpressions.example: Setting clear objectives is the first step to achieving them. 设定明确目标是实现目标的第一步。

advancedExpressions.expression: object 物体；反对 → objective 客观的；目标 → objectively 客观地 → objectivity 客观性；动词搭配 object to (doing) sth 反对（做）某事
advancedExpressions.example: She objected to the plan, but judged it objectively. 她反对该计划，但作出了客观评判。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（并列+主从复合）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句为 and 连接的并列祈使句：Be objective 和 make yourself open to...（make + 宾语 + 宾补 open）
advancedExpressions.example: Be objective and make yourself open to new knowledge and ideas. 两个祈使句并列，open to 作宾语补足语。

classPractice.question: The main objective of the meeting is ______ (give) more information on our plan.
classPractice.note: 不定式 to give 作表语，说明 objective 的具体内容。

classPractice.question: We should be objective ______ others' criticism and don't be oversensitive to their opinions.
classPractice.note: 课件答案：be objective to... 客观对待……，与后文 oversensitive to 呼应。

classPractice.question: The expert ___________________________ (作了客观的分析) on this report.
classPractice.note: make an objective analysis 作客观分析；objective 作定语。

classPractice.question: 要客观，并让自己接受新知识和新观念。
classPractice.answer: Be objective and make yourself open to new knowledge and ideas.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译：并列祈使句 + make sb open to 结构。

translation: vt. & vi. (also criticise) 批评，批判，挑剔，指责；评价
original_sentence: Do not criticize them or reject them simply because they differ from what you know or believe.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 评论，评价（文学、艺术作品，指出优缺点，不一定含贬义）
uncommonMeanings.example: We were asked to criticize the novel, pointing out both its strengths and weaknesses.

wordForms.noun: criticism 批评；评论（accept/face criticism）；critic 批评家，评论家（a film critic 影评人）
wordForms.verb: criticize（英式亦拼作 criticise）批评；评论
wordForms.adjective: critical 批评的；关键的，危急的（be critical of 对……挑剔/批评；be critical to 对……至关重要）
wordForms.adverb: critically 批判地；危急地（critically ill 病危）

translation: vi. & vt. & n. vi. & vt. 登记，注册 n. 语体风格，语域；登记表
original_sentence: Secondly, take advantage of opportunities for lifelong learning—for example, you could register online and subscribe to e-learning courses, which have become increasingly popular in recent years.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（仪表）显示（度数）（＝display）

uncommonMeanings.example: Surprise registered on her face. / Her face registered surprise.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】被注意到，被理解，被记住（＝make an impression）
uncommonMeanings.example: What I said sometimes didn't register in her brain. / It suddenly registered (with her) that...

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】正式提出（抗议、不满等）
uncommonMeanings.example: China has registered a protest over foreign intervention.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 登记簿，名册（take/call the register 点名）
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher called the register at the start of class.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 语域，语体风格（语言学术语）

wordForms.noun: registration 登记，注册（【课件】registration fee 注册费）；registrar 登记员，（大学）教务主任；register 本身兼作名词（登记表，名册；语域）
wordForms.verb: register 登记，注册；显示；流露

Surprise registered on her face. 她脸上流露出惊讶。

synonyms.example: I signed up for the gym. 我报名了健身房。
synonyms.usage: sign up for 为口语化短语动词；register 较正式，另有'显示、流露'等引申义

advancedExpressions.expression: register for 报名（课程）/ register at 在……登记 / register with 到……处登记 / registration fee 注册费
advancedExpressions.example: Register at the front desk and pay the registration fee.

advancedExpressions.expression: ①登记，注册 ②（仪表）显示 ③（情感）流露 ④被注意到，被理解 ⑤正式提出（抗议） ⑥n. 名册；语域

translation: vi. & vt. （使）停止，终止，结束
original_sentence: In summary, in a world of constant change, one should never cease to learn.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 停止（仅用于短语 without cease 不停地）
uncommonMeanings.example: The wind blew for a week without cease. 风不停地刮了一周。

wordForms.noun: cessation 停止，中止（smoking cessation 戒烟）；ceasefire 停火（协议）
wordForms.adjective: ceaseless 无休止的
wordForms.other: cease 比 stop 正式，多用于书面语；cease to do 与 cease doing 同义，没有 stop to do（停下来去做另一件事）那种区别

idioms.example: The court ordered the firm to cease and desist. 法院勒令该公司停止侵权。

collocations.translation: 【课件】永不停止学习（课文原句）
collocations.example: One should never cease to learn. 人不能停止学习。

collocations.translation: 【课件】停止做某事；不再做某事
collocations.example: You never cease to amaze me! 你总能让我感到惊奇！

collocations.translation: 【课件】真是无奇不有。（口语惊叹语）
collocations.example: He tidied his room? Wonders will never cease! 他收拾房间了？真是无奇不有！
He ordered his men to cease fire. 他命令士兵停火。
It rained for two days without cessation. 雨不停地下了两天。

collocations.translation: 停止做某事（与 cease to do 意义基本相同）
collocations.example: The company ceased trading last year. 这家公司去年停止了营业。

synonyms.example: The rain stopped at noon. 雨中午停了。
synonyms.usage: stop 为通用词，可接 doing（停止做）或 to do（停下来去做另一件事）；cease 为正式书面语，cease to do 与 cease doing 均表'停止做'，无歧义。

synonyms.example: The government halted the project. 政府叫停了该项目。
synonyms.usage: halt 侧重（因命令等）中途停住，常作及物动词或名词（come to a halt）；cease 侧重活动或状态的终止，主语多为事物或抽象活动。

advancedExpressions.expression: cease to do / cease doing / cease fire / without cessation / ceaseless 无休止的
advancedExpressions.example: You never cease to amaze me! 你总能让我感到惊奇！

advancedExpressions.expression: stop / cease / halt / quit / discontinue / suspend（暂停）
advancedExpressions.example: The magazine was discontinued last year. 该杂志去年停刊了。

advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 In summary, in a world of constant change, one should never cease to learn. 中 In summary 为总结性语篇标记语，in a world of constant change 为介词短语作状语，主干为 one should never cease to learn。
advancedExpressions.example: In summary, in a world of constant change, one should never cease to learn.

classPractice.question: 在瞬息万变的世界里，人永远不应停止学习。 In a world of constant change, one should never __________________.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；cease to do sth 停止做某事

classPractice.question: You never cease __________ (amaze) me with your new ideas!
classPractice.note: never cease to do sth 不断做某事，课件例句'你总能让我感到惊奇'

classPractice.question: 他命令士兵停火。
classPractice.answer: He ordered his men to cease fire.
classPractice.note: cease fire 停火（课件搭配）；合写 ceasefire 为名词'停火协议'

translation: n. 自我价值感
original_sentence: Lifelong learning will help you develop your skills and further your career, and will boost your sense of self-worth and keep your mind active.

wordForms.noun: worth n. 价值；worthiness n. 可贵，配得上
wordForms.adjective: worthy adj. 值得的（be worthy of）；worthwhile adj. 值得做的
wordForms.other: 构词法：self- + 名词构成复合名词，如 self-esteem 自尊、self-confidence 自信、self-discipline 自律；self-worth 不可数

collocations.translation: 增强自我价值感（课文原句）
collocations.example: Lifelong learning will boost your sense of self-worth. 终身学习会增强你的自我价值感。
Praise builds up a child's sense of self-worth. 表扬能培养孩子的自我价值感。
Failure at school left him with low self-worth. 学业失败使他自我价值感低下。

synonyms.example: Success raised her self-esteem. 成功提升了她的自尊。
synonyms.usage: self-esteem 与 self-worth 常可互换，都指对自身价值的评价；self-esteem 更常用（心理学术语），self-worth 侧重'觉得自己有价值'。均不可数，常与 boost/build up/raise/low/high 搭配。

synonyms.example: He behaved with great dignity. 他举止很有尊严。
synonyms.usage: dignity 指外在表现出的庄重与可受人尊重的品质；self-worth 是内在的自我评价，只与自己对自己的看法有关。

advancedExpressions.expression: self-worth 自我价值 / self-esteem 自尊 / self-confidence 自信 / self-discipline 自律 / self-improvement 自我提升 / self-assessment 自我评价
advancedExpressions.example: Lifelong learning is a road to self-improvement. 终身学习是自我提升之路。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·增强价值感
advancedExpressions.expression: boost/build up/strengthen one's sense of self-worth; raise one's self-esteem; make sb feel valued
advancedExpressions.example: Volunteering makes the elderly feel valued. 志愿服务让老人感到自己有价值。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（并列谓语）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句用 and 连接多个并列谓语：will help you develop... and further your career, and will boost... and keep...；分析长句先找并列连词 and，再逐段找谓语动词。
advancedExpressions.example: Lifelong learning will help you develop your skills and further your career, and will boost your sense of self-worth and keep your mind active.

classPractice.question: 终身学习会增强你的自我价值感，并让你的头脑保持活跃。 Lifelong learning will __________ your __________ of self-worth and keep your mind active.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；boost a sense of self-worth 增强自我价值感

classPractice.question: 用 self-worth / self-discipline / self-confidence 填空：Learning a new skill at 60 gave her a strong sense of __________.
classPractice.note: a sense of self-worth 自我价值感

classPractice.question: 帮助别人能提升我们的自我价值感。
classPractice.answer: Helping others can boost our sense of self-worth.
classPractice.note: boost/build up one's sense of self-worth

translation: adj. 归纳的，归纳法的
original_sentence: Many of our beliefs about the universe are based on inductive reasoning, also known as the scientific model.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （物理）电磁感应的（学科义）
uncommonMeanings.example: an inductive coil 感应线圈

wordForms.noun: induction n. 归纳（法）；就职（仪式）；入职培训；（物理）感应
wordForms.verb: induce v. 诱导，引起；招致
wordForms.other: 重音在第二音节 /ɪnˈdʌktɪv/；反义词 deductive 演绎的（v. deduce 推断）；构词：in-(进) + duct(引) + -ive

collocations.example: Science relies on inductive reasoning. 科学依赖归纳推理。
The teacher used an inductive approach to teach grammar. 老师用归纳法教语法。

collocations.translation: 以归纳推理为基础（课文原句结构）
collocations.example: Our beliefs are based on inductive reasoning. 我们的信念基于归纳推理。

synonyms.translation: 基于观察/实验的，实证的
synonyms.example: The theory is supported by empirical evidence. 该理论有实证证据支持。
synonyms.usage: empirical 指'凭观察或实验得来的'；inductive 指'由个别事实归纳出一般规律的'（from the specific to the general），二者都作定语；inductive 的反义词是 deductive 演绎的。

advancedExpressions.expression: duct = 引导：induce 诱导 / deduce 演绎推断 / produce 生产 / reduce 减少 / conduct 实施 / introduce 引入
advancedExpressions.example: in-(进) + duct(引) → 把个别事例'引入'归出结论 → 归纳的

advancedExpressions.expression: inductive reasoning 归纳推理：由特殊到一般、由具体到抽象（from the particular to the general）；deductive reasoning 演绎推理：由一般到特殊
advancedExpressions.example: Inductive reasoning proceeds from the specific to the abstract. 归纳推理由具体到抽象。

advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句中 also known as the scientific model 为过去分词短语作后置定语，补充说明 inductive reasoning，相当于非限制性定语从句 which is also known as...
advancedExpressions.example: Many of our beliefs about the universe are based on inductive reasoning, also known as the scientific model.

classPractice.question: Many of our beliefs about the universe are based on __________ (induction) reasoning.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；inductive reasoning 归纳推理

classPractice.question: 用 inductive / deductive 填空：Drawing a general rule from many examples is __________ reasoning, while applying a general rule to a specific case is __________ reasoning.
classPractice.note: 归纳：特殊→一般；演绎：一般→特殊

classPractice.question: Inductive reasoning, which is also known as the scientific model, moves from the specific to the general. → Inductive reasoning, also __________ __________ the scientific model, moves from the specific to the general.
classPractice.note: 过去分词短语作后置定语，替代非限制性定语从句

translation: n. 推理，理性的观点，论证
original_sentence: Many of our beliefs about the universe are based on inductive reasoning, also known as the scientific model.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有理性的，会思考的（作定语，书面语）
uncommonMeanings.example: Humans are reasoning animals. 人是理性动物。

wordForms.noun: reason n. 原因，理由；理性
wordForms.verb: reason v. 推理，推断；reason with sb 与某人讲道理
wordForms.adjective: reasonable adj. 合理的；（价格）公道的
wordForms.adverb: reasonably adv. 合理地；相当地
wordForms.other: reasoning 不可数；reason 的常用结构：reason for sth / reason to do / the reason why 从句

collocations.example: Our beliefs are based on inductive reasoning. 我们的信念基于归纳推理。
The case was solved through logical reasoning. 案件通过逻辑推理得以侦破。
What's the reasoning behind this decision? 这个决定背后的理由是什么？
I couldn't follow his line of reasoning. 我跟不上他的推理思路。

synonyms.example: There's no logic in his argument. 他的论证毫无逻辑。
synonyms.usage: logic 指逻辑体系或条理本身；reasoning 指运用逻辑得出结论的'推理过程'，常与 inductive/deductive/logical 连用。二者均不可数。

synonyms.example: Her argument was convincing. 她的论证很有说服力。
synonyms.usage: argument 可数，指一套具体的论证或论据；reasoning 不可数，指推理活动本身。

advancedExpressions.expression: reason with sb 与某人讲道理 / it stands to reason that... ……是理所当然的 / by reason of 由于 / beyond all reason 毫无道理
advancedExpressions.example: It stands to reason that lifelong learners adapt better. 终身学习者适应力更强是理所当然的。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·推理与思考
advancedExpressions.expression: reasoning / logic / analysis / judgement / critical thinking 批判性思维
advancedExpressions.example: Critical thinking involves careful reasoning. 批判性思维需要缜密的推理。

advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句主干为 Many of our beliefs are based on inductive reasoning，about the universe 为介词短语作后置定语，also known as... 为过去分词短语补充说明 reasoning。
advancedExpressions.example: Many of our beliefs about the universe are based on inductive reasoning, also known as the scientific model.

classPractice.question: 我们关于宇宙的许多信念都基于归纳推理。 Many of our beliefs about the universe are __________ __________ inductive reasoning.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；be based on 以……为基础

classPractice.question: His __________ (reason) was sound, so we all accepted the conclusion.
classPractice.note: reasoning 推理（不可数名词）

classPractice.question: 我跟不上他的推理思路。
classPractice.answer: I couldn't follow his line of reasoning.
classPractice.note: a line of reasoning 推理思路

translation: adj. & vt. adj. 抽象的，纯理论的 /æbˈstrækt/ vt. 把……抽象出，提取
original_sentence: In other words, it is a way to proceed from the particular to the general, from the specific to the abstract.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （论文、报告的）摘要；抽象派作品
uncommonMeanings.example: Read the abstract before the full paper. 读全文之前先读摘要。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 提取，抽取；写……的摘要
uncommonMeanings.example: The data was abstracted from the report. 这些数据摘自那份报告。

wordForms.noun: abstract n. 摘要；abstraction n. 抽象（概念）；心不在焉
wordForms.verb: abstract vt. 提取；做摘要
wordForms.adjective: abstract adj. 抽象的
wordForms.other: 重音区分：adj./n. /ˈæbstrækt/ 重音在前，v. /æbˈstrækt/ 重音在后（类似 record、present）；反义词 concrete 具体的

collocations.phrase: from the specific to the abstract
collocations.translation: 由具体到抽象（课文原句，the + adj. 表一类抽象概念）
collocations.example: Inductive reasoning proceeds from the specific to the abstract. 归纳推理由具体到抽象。
Freedom is an abstract concept. 自由是一个抽象概念。
He collects abstract paintings. 他收藏抽象画。
We discussed the problem in the abstract. 我们从理论上讨论了这个问题。
Metals are abstracted from ore. 金属是从矿石中提取的。

synonyms.example: It's only a theoretical possibility. 那只是理论上的可能性。
synonyms.usage: theoretical 指'基于理论而非实践的'；abstract 指'脱离具体实例、看不见摸不着的'，反义词是 concrete。abstract 可作定语（abstract idea）或表语（The idea is too abstract.）。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the + 形容词表抽象概念
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 from the particular to the general, from the specific to the abstract 中 the + adj. 表一类抽象事物；类似 the unknown 未知的事物 / the impossible 不可能的事
advancedExpressions.example: In other words, it is a way to proceed from the particular to the general, from the specific to the abstract.

advancedExpressions.expression: tract = 拉：abstract 抽（离）出→抽象 / attract 吸引 / contract 合同；收缩 / distract 分散（注意力）/ extract 提取
advancedExpressions.example: abs-(离开) + tract(拉) → 从具体事物中'抽'出来 → 抽象的

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·抽象与具体
advancedExpressions.expression: abstract ↔ concrete；general ↔ particular/specific；theory ↔ practice
advancedExpressions.example: Teaching should move from the concrete to the abstract. 教学应由具体到抽象。

classPractice.question: 这是一种由特殊到一般、由具体到抽象的方法。 It is a way to proceed from the particular to the general, from the specific to the __________.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；the + adj. 表一类抽象概念

classPractice.question: 用 abstract / concrete 填空：'Love' is an __________ noun, while 'desk' is a __________ noun.
classPractice.note: abstract 抽象的 ↔ concrete 具体的

classPractice.question: 请先读这篇论文的摘要。
classPractice.answer: Please read the abstract of the paper first.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义：abstract n. /ˈæbstrækt/（论文）摘要

translation: n. 天鹅
original_sentence: This is known as the “black swan theory”.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 悠然闲逛，优哉游哉地游荡（swan around/off）
uncommonMeanings.example: She spent the summer swanning around Europe. 她整个夏天在欧洲悠哉游哉地闲逛。

wordForms.noun: swan 天鹅（复数 swans）；cygnet 小天鹅（天鹅幼鸟）
wordForms.other: 发音贴士：swan 读 /swɒn/，w 后的 a 发 /ɒ/ 不发 /æ/（比较 want, wash, watch 同理）

idioms.translation: 绝唱，告别之作（源自"天鹅临死鸣唱"的传说）
idioms.example: This film proved to be the director's swan song. 这部电影成了这位导演的绝唱。

idioms.translation: 黑天鹅（喻指无法预测、影响巨大的意外事件）
idioms.example: Investors should always prepare for a black swan. 投资者应时刻为黑天鹅事件做好准备。

collocations.example: This is known as the "black swan theory". 这被称为"黑天鹅理论"。
He is known as "the King of Pop". 他被称为"流行音乐之王"。

collocations.translation: 黑天鹅事件（极难预料的重大事件）
collocations.example: The financial crisis was a typical black swan event. 那场金融危机是典型的黑天鹅事件。
A flock of swans landed on the lake. 一群天鹅落在湖面上。

advancedExpressions.expression: be known as 被称为 / be known for 因……而闻名 / be known to sb 为某人所知
advancedExpressions.example: The city is known for its gardens and known as "Garden City". 这城市以园林闻名，被称为"花园城市"。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（本单元）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 This is known as the "black swan theory". 为被动语态简单句；课文随后用 that/which 定语从句解释 theory 的内容，阅读长难句时先抓主句"This is known as..."，再顺藤摸瓜找从句修饰对象
advancedExpressions.example: This is known as the "black swan theory", which refers to events that nobody can predict. 这被称为"黑天鹅理论"，指无人能预测的事件。

classPractice.question:
这被称为"黑天鹅理论"。
This ____ ____ ____ the "black swan theory".
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；be known as 被称为，as 后接名称/身份

classPractice.question: Nobody saw the crisis coming—it was a real "black ____" (天鹅) event.
classPractice.note: black swan event 黑天鹅事件，源自课文 black swan theory

classPractice.question: 那场告别演唱会被媒体称为她的"绝唱"。
classPractice.answer: The farewell concert was called/known as her "swan song" by the media.
classPractice.note: swan song 绝唱、告别之作，来自天鹅临死鸣唱的传说

translation: n. 假定，假设
original_sentence: Before the first black swan was seen, the assumption was that all swans were white.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （权力、责任的）承担，就任（the assumption of power/office）
uncommonMeanings.example: His assumption of office took place in March. 他于三月就职。

wordForms.noun: assumption 假定；（权力的）承担
wordForms.verb: assume 假定，认为；承担（责任）；呈现（assume importance）
wordForms.adjective: assumed 假定的；假装的（an assumed name 化名）
wordForms.other: 构词：assume 去 e 加 -ption→assumption（比较 consume→consumption, presume→presumption）；assuming (that)... 可作连词"假设……"：Assuming that it's true, what should we do?

collocations.translation: 当时的假设是……（课文原句）
collocations.example: Before the first black swan was seen, the assumption was that all swans were white. 在第一只黑天鹅被发现前，人们的假设是所有天鹅都是白色的。
We planned the trip on the assumption that it wouldn't rain. 我们是假定不会下雨来计划这次旅行的。
Don't make assumptions about people you've never met. 不要对素未谋面的人妄下断言。
Good scientists constantly question their own assumptions. 优秀的科学家不断质疑自己的假设。
There is a common assumption that older people can't learn new skills. 人们普遍认为老年人学不会新技能。

synonyms.example: The experiment was designed to test the hypothesis. 这个实验是为验证该假说而设计的。
synonyms.usage: hypothesis 指科研中有待实验验证的假说，复数 hypotheses；assumption 指未经证实就当作事实接受的想法，日常和学术均可用，常见结构 on the assumption that

synonyms.example: There is a presumption of innocence in law. 法律上有无罪推定。
synonyms.usage: presumption 更正式，多用于法律语境（基于概率或规则的推定）；assumption 为通用词。两者都可后接 that 同位语从句

advancedExpressions.expression: assume that... 假定 / It is assumed that... 人们认为 / assume responsibility for 承担……的责任
advancedExpressions.example: It is widely assumed that learning stops after school, but it never should. 人们普遍以为学习止于学校，但其实不该如此。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（本单元）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句为主从复合句：Before... was seen 是时间状语从句（被动语态），主句主干为 the assumption was + that 引导的表语从句（that all swans were white）；表语从句中 that 不可省略
advancedExpressions.example: Before the first black swan was seen, the assumption was that all swans were white.

advancedExpressions.expression: assumption 假设 / belief 信念 / notion 观念 / hypothesis 假说 / presumption 推定
advancedExpressions.example: The old notion/assumption that age limits learning has been proved wrong. 年龄限制学习这一旧观念已被证明是错的。

classPractice.question:
在第一只黑天鹅被发现之前，人们的假设是所有天鹅都是白色的。
Before the first black swan was seen, ____ ____ ____ that all swans were white.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；that 引导表语从句，that 不能省略

classPractice.question: We are working on the ____ (assume) that the meeting will go ahead as planned.
classPractice.note: on the assumption that... 基于……的假设；assume→assumption 去 e 加 -ption

classPractice.question: Many people wrongly ____ (assumption) that money always brings happiness.
classPractice.note: 谓语位置需动词 assume that...；主语 many people 用原形

translation: n. 领域，范围；领土；域

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 领土，领地；势力范围（历史/文学语境）
uncommonMeanings.example: The island was once part of the king's domain. 这座岛曾是国王领地的一部分。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （互联网）域；域名（熟词僻义，如 domain name）
uncommonMeanings.example: Websites ending in ".edu" belong to the education domain. 以 .edu 结尾的网站属于教育域。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （函数的）定义域
uncommonMeanings.example: Find the domain of the function f(x). 求函数 f(x) 的定义域。

wordForms.noun: domain 领域；领土；域（复数 domains）
wordForms.other: 词源：拉丁语 dominus（主人）→ domain（主人管辖之地→领域）、dominate 支配、dominant 占主导的、predominant 占绝对优势的；发音重音在第二音节 /dəˈmeɪn/

collocations.example: She is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence. 她是人工智能领域的专家。

collocations.translation: 属于公共领域；已公之于众
collocations.example: This information is already in the public domain. 这一信息已进入公共领域。

collocations.translation: 在某人的职责/专业范围之外/之内
collocations.example: Legal questions are outside my domain. 法律问题不属于我的专业范围。
The company registered a new domain name last week. 公司上周注册了一个新域名。

synonyms.example: He works in the field of education. 他在教育领域工作。
synonyms.usage: field 最常用最口语，in the field of...；domain 更正式，强调专属或管辖的范围（the exclusive domain of experts）；两者都作名词，常置于 in the ___ of 结构中

synonyms.example: Such ideas belong to the realm of science fiction. 这类想法属于科幻的范畴。
synonyms.usage: realm 偏书面/文学，常与抽象概念连用（the realm of imagination/possibility）；domain 偏学术与专业管辖范围

synonyms.example: China's influence in the economic sphere keeps growing. 中国在经济领域的影响力不断增长。
synonyms.usage: sphere 强调活动/影响所及的范围，典型搭配 sphere of influence 势力范围；四词都是名词，作表语或介词宾语

advancedExpressions.expression: field / domain / realm / sphere / area / territory（比喻义）
advancedExpressions.example: Lifelong learning covers every domain/field of life. 终身学习覆盖生活的每一个领域。

advancedExpressions.expression: domain 领域 / dominate 支配 / dominant 主导的 / predominant 占优势的
advancedExpressions.example: English is dominant in the domain of international academic writing. 英语在国际学术写作领域占主导。

translation: adj. 职业的，业务知识的
original_sentence: B2 The passage below is about Leon’s experience of vocational education in Germany.

uncommonMeanings.partOfSpeech: n.（词族 vocation 的熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.meaning: vocation 除"职业"外还指"天职，使命感"
uncommonMeanings.example: Nursing is not just a job for her—it's a vocation. 护理对她而言不只是工作，更是天职。

wordForms.noun: vocation 职业；天职，使命感（a vocation for teaching 教书的天职）
wordForms.adjective: vocational 职业的，业务知识的
wordForms.adverb: vocationally 职业上（vocationally oriented courses 以职业为导向的课程）
wordForms.other: 构词：vocation + -al→vocational；词根 voc-/vok- = call（呼唤）：vocation（受召唤而做的事→天职）、vocal 嗓音的、advocate 提倡、vocabulary 词汇、provoke 激起

collocations.example: The passage is about Leon's experience of vocational education in Germany. 这篇文章讲Leon在德国接受职业教育的经历。
The company offers free vocational training to new workers. 公司为新员工提供免费职业培训。
After Grade 9, he entered a vocational school. 九年级后他进入了一所职业学校。
The course helps students develop practical vocational skills. 这门课帮助学生培养实用的职业技能。

synonyms.example: You should seek professional advice before investing. 投资前应寻求专业意见。
synonyms.usage: vocational 指"与职业技能培养相关的"，几乎只作定语，修饰 education/training/school 等；professional 指"专业人士的、职业水准的"，可作定语也可作表语（He is very professional.）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·词根 voc-（call 呼唤）
advancedExpressions.expression: vocation 天职 / vocational 职业的 / vocal 发声的 / advocate 提倡 / vocabulary 词汇 / provoke 激起
advancedExpressions.example: He found his true vocation in vocational teaching. 他在职业教育教学中找到了自己真正的使命。

advancedExpressions.expression: vocational education 职业教育 / higher education 高等教育 / compulsory education 义务教育 / adult education 成人教育 / distance education 远程教育
advancedExpressions.example: Germany is famous for its dual system of vocational education. 德国以其"双元制"职业教育闻名。

classPractice.question: In Germany, many students choose ____ (vocation) training after finishing secondary school.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 training 用形容词 vocational；vocation+-al

classPractice.question:
这篇文章是关于Leon在德国接受职业教育的经历。
The passage is about Leon's experience of ____ ____ in Germany.

classPractice.note: not just...but... 并列结构；vocation 天职（vocational 的名词）

translation: n. 工作，职业；消遣；侵占，占领期；使用
original_sentence: At school, he attended classes relevant to his chosen occupation.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】消遣，业余活动（= pastime）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her main occupation seems to be shopping. 她的主要消遣似乎就是购物。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】占领，侵占；占领期（under occupation 被占领）
uncommonMeanings.example: The city suffered greatly during the military occupation. 军事占领期间这座城市损失惨重。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】居住，使用（人对土地/房屋的占用）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the first scientists came to the region they found little evidence of human occupation. 第一批科学家来到该地区时，基本没发现人类居住过的痕迹。

wordForms.noun: occupation 职业；消遣；占领；居住 / occupant 居住者，占用者（= resident）【课件】 / occupancy 占用（率），居住【课件：Hotel occupancy has been as low as 40%. 酒店入住率低至40%】
wordForms.verb: occupy 占用（时间、空间）（= take up）【课件】；占领；使忙于（occupy oneself with）
wordForms.adjective: occupational 职业的（occupational disease 职业病）【课件】；occupied 被占用的，无空闲的
wordForms.other: occupy 变形：occupied/occupied/occupying（辅音字母+y 变 i 加 -ed）；名词后缀 -ation：occupy→occupation

collocations.translation: 自己选定的职业（课文原句）
collocations.example: At school, he attended classes relevant to his chosen occupation. 在学校，他上与所选职业相关的课程。

collocations.phrase: regardless of the gender and occupation
collocations.example: Everyone deserves respect regardless of the gender and occupation. 无论性别和职业，人人都应受到尊重。
The area is under occupation. 该地区正被占领。
Back pain is a common occupational disease among drivers. 背痛是司机常见的职业病。
She is fully occupied with work. 她工作忙得不可开交。
I kept the kids occupied by reading them a book. 我给孩子们读书，让他们有事可做。
He only reads articles relevant to his research. 他只读与其研究相关的文章。

synonyms.example: Teaching is a demanding profession. 教书是一份要求很高的职业。
synonyms.usage: profession 指须受高等教育或专门训练的职业（医生、律师、教师）；occupation 是正式统称，表格中"职业"一栏常用 occupation；两者都是可数名词

synonyms.example: She had a brilliant career in law. 她在法律界事业辉煌。
synonyms.usage: career 强调一生从事的事业及其发展历程（career prospects 职业前景）；occupation 只指当前所从事的工作，不含"生涯"之意

synonyms.example: He got a part-time job in a bookstore. 他在书店找了份兼职。
synonyms.usage: job 最口语、最通用，可数；work 不可数；occupation 为书面正式语。四词都作名词，occupation/profession 不用于 do a ~ 结构

advancedExpressions.expression: be occupied with sth / be occupied in doing sth 忙于 / keep sb occupied 让某人有事做 / occupy oneself with 使自己忙于 / occupy = take up 占用（时间空间）
advancedExpressions.example: Learning new skills keeps retired people happily occupied. 学习新技能让退休的人们充实而快乐。

advancedExpressions.expression: job 工作（可数）/ work 工作（不可数）/ occupation 职业（正式）/ profession 专门职业 / career 生涯 / employment 就业 / vocation 天职
advancedExpressions.example: Please state your name, age and occupation on the form. 请在表格上写明姓名、年龄和职业。

classPractice.answer: regardless of the gender and occupation
classPractice.note: regardless of 不管，不顾；课件原题

translation: vt. & vi. vt. 使合格，使具备资格 vi. 取得资格（或学历），合格

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 晋级，取得参赛资格（qualify for the final/the World Cup）
uncommonMeanings.example: Our team qualified for the finals. 我们队晋级了决赛。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 对（陈述）加以限定，使缓和
uncommonMeanings.example: I'd like to qualify my earlier statement. 我想对我先前的话作些限定说明。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 修饰，限定
uncommonMeanings.example: Adjectives qualify nouns. 形容词修饰名词。

wordForms.noun: qualification 资格，学历；资格证书（常用复数 qualifications）【课件】；quality 质量，品质【课件：be of high quality 质量高】
wordForms.verb: qualify（qualified, qualified, qualifying）使合格；取得资格
wordForms.adjective: qualified 有资格的，胜任的（be qualified for/to do）；qualifying 资格赛的（a qualifying match 资格赛）
wordForms.other: 构词：-ify 动词后缀（qualify/simplify/classify/beautify），对应名词后缀 -ification（qualification/simplification）；注意区分 qualification（资格）与 quality（质量、品质）

collocations.example: This training course will qualify you for a better job. 这门培训课程将使你有资格获得更好的工作。
The certificate qualifies her to teach English abroad. 这个证书使她有资格在国外教英语。
He qualified as a doctor last year. 他去年获得了医生的资格。
These guides are qualified to lead groups. 这些导游具备带团的资格。

collocations.phrase: have the right qualifications to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】具备做某事的合适资格/学历
collocations.example: Few applicants have the right qualifications to do the job. 几乎没有申请人具备做这份工作的合适资格。
The products are of high quality. 这些产品质量很高。

synonyms.example: This ticket entitles you to a free meal. 这张票使你有权享受一顿免费餐。
synonyms.usage: entitle sb to sth / to do sth，强调赋予"权利"（法律、规则赋予）；qualify sb for sth / to do sth，强调通过训练、考试等具备"资格能力"。两者都是及物动词，宾语后接介词短语或不定式

synonyms.example: She is certified as a yoga instructor. 她持有瑜伽教练认证。
synonyms.usage: certify 侧重官方"发证认证"这一动作（be certified as）；qualify 侧重"达到资格标准"；qualify 还可作不及物动词（qualify as/for），certify 一般用被动

advancedExpressions.expression: qualify for sth 有资格获得 / qualify as... 取得……资格 / qualify sb for sth 使某人有资格获得 / qualify sb to do sth 使某人有资格做 / be qualified for sth / be qualified to do sth 胜任
advancedExpressions.example: Two years of study qualified him to work as a nurse. 两年的学习使他有资格当护士。

advancedExpressions.expression: qualify→qualification / simplify→simplification / identify→identification / classify→classification
advancedExpressions.example: You need formal qualifications to qualify for this position. 你需要正式学历才有资格获得这个职位。

advancedExpressions.expression: qualification 资格、学历（可数，常复数）；quality 质量、品质（be of high/good quality）
advancedExpressions.example: He has the qualifications, and his work is of high quality. 他有资格证书，而且工作质量很高。

classPractice.question: This training course will qualify you ____ a better job.
classPractice.note: qualify sb for sth 使某人有资格获得……；课件原题

classPractice.note: qualify as+身份名词 取得……的资格；课件原题

classPractice.note: be of high quality 质量高；注意 quality（质量）≠ qualification（资格）；课件原题

translation: n. 成功的机会，前景；可能性

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 可能性（= possibility，常接 of doing sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: There is no prospect of the strike ending soon.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常用复数 prospects）成功的机会，前途，前程
uncommonMeanings.example: The job offers excellent promotion prospects.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （脑海中对未来的）设想，展望（vision or an idea）
uncommonMeanings.example: The prospect of a whole week alone excited her.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】可能成为主顾（或获胜者）的人；有前途的人
uncommonMeanings.example: The club regards the young player as a top prospect.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】勘探，勘察（prospect for gold/oil/minerals）
uncommonMeanings.example: Thousands rushed west to prospect for gold.

wordForms.noun: prospect 前景，可能性；prospector 勘探者
wordForms.verb: prospect (for) 勘探
wordForms.adjective: prospective 可能的，预期的，潜在的（prospective buyers/clients/candidates，只作定语）
wordForms.other: 重音贴士：名词 /ˈprɒspekt/ 重音在前，动词英式常读 /prəˈspekt/。'前途、成功机会'义习惯用复数 prospects。

collocations.example: There is little prospect of any improvement in the weather. 天气几乎没有好转的可能。

collocations.phrase: there is every prospect of (doing) sth
collocations.example: There is every prospect of success. 大有成功的希望。

collocations.translation: 【课件】即将来临，有望发生（= coming soon）
collocations.example: Major developments are in prospect for the company. 公司即将有重大发展。

collocations.translation: 【课件】就业/职业前景（'成功机会'义常用复数）
collocations.example: Career prospects for graduates do not look good. 毕业生的就业前景不容乐观。

collocations.translation: 【课件】前景好的行业（= a promising industry）
collocations.example: IT is an industry with good prospects. IT 是一个前景好的行业。
She wasn't overjoyed at the prospect of looking after her niece. 一想到要照看侄女她就高兴不起来。
He had prospected for minerals from the Gobi Desert to the Transvaal. 他从戈壁沙漠到德兰士瓦到处勘探矿产。

synonyms.example: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
synonyms.usage: possibility 泛指客观可能性，可接 of doing 或 that 从句；prospect 强调对未来的预期，常用 prospect of doing，不接 that 从句；'成功机会'义用复数 prospects，常与 for sb/sth 连用。

synonyms.example: The economic outlook remains uncertain.
synonyms.usage: outlook 常用单数，指对总体形势的展望（the outlook for the economy）；prospects 复数指个人/行业的具体发展机会（career prospects）。

advancedExpressions.expression: an industry with good prospects = a promising industry = an industry with a bright future
advancedExpressions.example: AI is a promising industry with good prospects.

advancedExpressions.expression: in prospect 即将发生 / at the prospect of 一想到…… / prospects for sb/sth ……的前景 / every prospect of 很有可能
advancedExpressions.example: With exams in prospect, he trembled at the prospect of failing.

advancedExpressions.expression: spect=看：prospect（向前看→前景）、inspect（向里看→检查）、respect（再看→尊重）、expect（向外看→期待）、suspect（向下看→怀疑）、spectator（观众）
advancedExpressions.example: pro-（向前）+ spect（看）→ 向前看到的景象，即'前景'。

classPractice.note: 课件原题：prospects（复数）表'成功的机会'；promising 有前途的。

classPractice.note: 课件原题：prospective 预期的、可能的，只作定语。

classPractice.answer: She wasn't overjoyed at the prospect of looking after her niece.
classPractice.note: at the prospect of doing sth 一想到……；课件例句。

translation: adj. & n. adj. 机动车的，汽车的 n. 发动机，马达

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 发动机，马达（多指电动机）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 机动车的，汽车的（只作定语）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】（英，旧）开汽车出行
uncommonMeanings.example: They motored down to the coast at the weekend.

wordForms.noun: motor 发动机；motorist 驾车者；motorway（英）高速公路；motorcycle/motorbike 摩托车；motorcyclist 摩托车手
wordForms.verb: motor（旧）驾车出行；motorize 使机动化
wordForms.adjective: motor 机动车的；运动神经的（两义均只作定语）；motorized 机动化的
wordForms.other: 构词贴士：mot- = move 动（motion 运动、motive 动机、motivate 激励、promote 促进、remote 遥远的）；motel = motor + hotel 汽车旅馆（混成词）。

collocations.example: He works in the motor industry. 他在汽车行业工作。

The fan is driven by an electric motor. 风扇由电动机驱动。

synonyms.example: The car engine won't start.

advancedExpressions.expression: motor skills 运动技能 / motor vehicle 机动车 / motor racing 赛车运动 / motorway（英）高速公路 / motor insurance 车险
advancedExpressions.example: Fine motor skills develop rapidly in early childhood.

advancedExpressions.example: motivation（学习动机）与 motor 同根，都含'动'的意思。
