classPractice.note: 熟词僻义：motor adj. 运动神经的、肌肉运动的；fine motor skills 精细运动技能。

translation: n. 机构；风俗习惯，制度

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （大型）机构（大学、银行、医院、教会等）
uncommonMeanings.example: a research institution

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （由来已久的）制度，风俗习惯
uncommonMeanings.example: the institution of the family

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （收容老人、孤儿等的）福利机构，收容所
uncommonMeanings.example: He has lived in an institution since childhood.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】（不可数）（制度、规则等的）建立，设立
uncommonMeanings.example: the institution of a new law

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】（幽默）众人熟悉的知名人物（或事物）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old professor is quite an institution at the university.

wordForms.noun: institution 机构；制度；institute（研究）所，学院
wordForms.verb: institute 建立，制定；开始，提起（institute a policy 制定政策 / institute legal proceedings 提起诉讼）
wordForms.adjective: institutional 机构的，制度的
wordForms.other: 辨析贴士：institute 多指专门的研究所/学院，常用于专名（the Institute of Physics）；institution 泛指大型机构，且有'制度、风俗'义。重音在第三音节 /ˌɪnstɪˈtjuːʃn/。

collocations.example: Universities are educational institutions. 大学是教育机构。
She applied to several institutions of higher learning. 她申请了几所高等院校。
Banks are financial institutions. 银行是金融机构。
The institution of marriage dates back thousands of years. 婚姻制度可追溯到几千年前。

collocations.translation: 新规则/法律的制定，设立
collocations.example: Workers welcomed the institution of new safety rules. 工人们欢迎新安全规则的制定。

synonyms.example: a non-profit organization
synonyms.usage: organization 最泛，指任何有组织的团体；institution 指历史较久、规模较大、承担社会职能的机构（大学、银行、教会），且可指'制度'——organization 无此义。两者都是可数名词，句法位置相同。

synonyms.example: a research institute
synonyms.usage: institute 通常指从事研究或教学的专门机构，多用于机构名称；作动词意为'制定，建立'。institution 词义范围更宽，还可指制度、收容所。

advancedExpressions.expression: enrol at an institution 在某院校注册入学 / a degree-granting institution 有学位授予权的院校 / an institution of higher learning 高等学府
advancedExpressions.example: He enrolled at an institution of higher learning at 40—never too old to learn.

advancedExpressions.expression: stitut- = stand 站立，设立：institute（设立）、institution（机构/制度）、constitute（构成）、constitution（宪法；体质）、substitute（替代）
advancedExpressions.example: in-（在内）+ stitut（设立）+ -ion → 被设立之物 → 机构、制度。

classPractice.question: The university, ________ (found) in 1885, is one of the oldest institutions of higher learning in the country.
classPractice.note: 过去分词作定语表被动；institution of higher learning 高等学府。

classPractice.question: 用 institution/institute 填空：① He works at a research ________ of the Academy of Sciences. ② Marriage is a social ________.
classPractice.note: 专门研究所用 institute；'制度'义只能用 institution。

classPractice.question: 银行和保险公司都是金融机构。（institution）
classPractice.answer: Banks and insurance companies are both financial institutions.
classPractice.note: financial institution 金融机构。

translation: vt. & vi. 培训，训练；钻（孔） n. 练习，训练；钻，钻头

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 钻，钻头（工具）
uncommonMeanings.example: a dentist's drill

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （反复的）操练，训练；演习
uncommonMeanings.example: a fire drill; grammar drills

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·熟词僻义】（the drill）正确的步骤，程序（英式口语，= procedure）
uncommonMeanings.example: What's the drill for filling in time sheets?

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 钻（孔）；钻探
uncommonMeanings.example: They drilled through the rock.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （通过反复练习）训练，操练（drill sb in sth / drill sb to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: She drills her students in pronunciation every morning.

wordForms.noun: drill 钻，钻头；操练，演习；drilling 钻探；反复操练
wordForms.verb: drill 钻（孔）；训练（drilled, drilled, drilling）
wordForms.other: 一词两线记忆：'钻孔'线（drill a hole / drill for oil / an electric drill）与'操练'线（a fire drill / drill sb to do sth）；口语熟词僻义 the drill = 正确步骤。

collocations.example: He made the holes with an electric drill. 他用电钻打的孔。
There have been proposals to drill for more oil. 有人提议钻探更多石油。
We go through a fire drill every term. 我们每学期进行一次消防演习。
The children were drilled to leave the classroom quickly. 孩子们受过快速撤离教室的训练。

collocations.translation: 【课件】语音/语法（反复操练式）练习
collocations.example: We teach by real communication rather than repetitive drilling. 我们通过真实交际而非机械操练来教学。
Drill two holes in the wall for the screws. 在墙上钻两个装螺丝的孔。
Safety rules were drilled into us from day one. 安全守则从第一天起就被反复灌输给我们。

synonyms.example: They were trained to survive in the jungle.
synonyms.usage: train 泛指系统地培训（train sb to do / train as a doctor）；drill 强调通过反复机械练习形成条件反射（drill sb in sth / drill sb to do sth），多用于军事、应急演习、语言操练。

synonyms.example: Do more listening exercises after class.
synonyms.usage: exercise 指一般性练习题；drill 特指同一形式反复操练的练习（pronunciation drills）；两者都可数，都可作 do 的宾语。

advancedExpressions.expression: drill for oil 钻探石油 / drill sth into sb 反复灌输 / drill sb in sth 操练某人某方面 / a fire drill 消防演习 / know the drill 知道该怎么做
advancedExpressions.example: You've been here before—you know the drill.

advancedExpressions.expression: the drill = the correct procedure 正确步骤（课件：What's the drill for filling in time sheets?）
advancedExpressions.example: What's the drill for applying for a student visa?

classPractice.question: The children were drilled to leave the classroom quickly ________________________. 孩子们受过训练：当火警铃拉响时迅速离开教室。
classPractice.note: 课件原题；drill sb to do sth 训练某人做某事，此处为被动 be drilled to do。

classPractice.question: There have been proposals to drill ________ more oil.
classPractice.note: drill for sth 钻探（开采）……，课件例句。

classPractice.question: 我们每学期都进行一次消防演习。（drill）
classPractice.answer: We do/practise/go through a fire drill every term.
classPractice.note: do/practise/go through a fire drill，课件搭配。

translation: n. 电路，线路；环行；赛车道

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 电路，线路
uncommonMeanings.example: The circuit was overloaded.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 环行（一周）；环形路线
uncommonMeanings.example: a circuit of the lake

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （环形）赛车道
uncommonMeanings.example: the Shanghai International Circuit

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】巡回赛；巡回活动（同一批人定期参加的一系列活动）
uncommonMeanings.example: He joined the professional golf circuit.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【熟词僻义】（健身）循环训练（circuit training）
uncommonMeanings.example: She does circuits at the gym twice a week.

wordForms.noun: circuit 电路；环行；circuitry（总称）电路系统
wordForms.adjective: circuitous 迂回的，绕行的（a circuitous route）
wordForms.other: 构词贴士：circ- = ring 圆环（circle, circus, circular, circulate, circumstance）；发音 /ˈsɜːkɪt/，注意 -cuit 读 /kɪt/；closed-circuit television = CCTV 闭路电视。

collocations.example: The students built a simple electric circuit. 学生们搭了一个简单电路。
A short circuit caused the fire. 短路引发了火灾。
He repaired the circuit board of the computer. 他修好了电脑的电路板。
Flipping the switch completes the circuit. 合上开关就接通了电路。
We made a circuit of the old town walls. 我们沿老城墙绕行了一圈。
The new circuit hosts the Chinese Grand Prix. 这条新赛道承办中国大奖赛。
She is a regular on the lecture circuit. 她经常做巡回演讲。

synonyms.example: Draw a circle on the paper.
synonyms.usage: circle 指几何图形'圆'或'圈子'；circuit 指绕行一圈的路线/行程和'电路'，是运动或线路概念：make a circuit of = go around；'电路、赛道'义只能用 circuit。

synonyms.example: He ran ten laps of the track.
synonyms.usage: lap 专指赛道/泳道计量用的'一圈'；circuit 指环形路线本身，也指赛道这一场地（a racing circuit）。

advancedExpressions.expression: a short circuit 短路 / a circuit board 电路板 / circuit training 循环训练 / closed-circuit television (CCTV) 闭路电视 / make a circuit of 绕行一周
advancedExpressions.example: The mall is monitored by closed-circuit television.

advancedExpressions.expression: circ-/circum- = around 环绕：circuit（环行→电路/赛道）、circle（圆）、circulate（循环，流通）、circular（圆形的；循环的）、circumstance（周围情形→环境）
advancedExpressions.example: circuit = circ（环）+ it（走）→ 绕着走的一圈。

classPractice.question: 用 circuit/circle 填空：① The fire was caused by a short ________ in the old wiring. ② The children sat in a ________ around the teacher.
classPractice.note: a short circuit 短路为固定搭配；'围成一圈'用 circle。

classPractice.question: 跑道太挤了，于是我们绕公园环行了一圈。（make a circuit of）
classPractice.answer: The track was too crowded, so we made a circuit of the park.
classPractice.note: make/do a circuit of ... 绕……环行一周。

classPractice.question: An electrician must understand how an electrical ________ works before starting the job. 电工开工前必须懂得电路的工作原理。
classPractice.note: 呼应本单元语法语篇（Leon 受训成为电工）；electrical circuit 电路。

translation: n. 能力，胜任
original_sentence: Leon graduated after demonstrating the appropriate level of understanding and technical competence, (6) _________________ he now anticipates a long and happy career as an electrician.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 能力，胜任（不可数，常与 in/professional/technical 搭配）
uncommonMeanings.example: No one doubts her professional competence.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件·熟词僻义】权限，职权范围（within/outside sb's competence）
uncommonMeanings.example: Such decisions are outside the competence of this court.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （可数，也作 competency）（某项具体的）技能，能力
uncommonMeanings.example: The course develops key competences such as teamwork.

wordForms.noun: competence（也作 competency）能力，胜任；incompetence 无能，不称职
wordForms.adjective: competent 有能力的，胜任的；incompetent 不称职的
wordForms.other: 重音在第一音节 /ˈkɒmpɪtəns/。辨析贴士：compete（竞争）家族是 competition/competitor/competitive；competent（胜任）家族是 competence/incompetence，两条词义线分开记。

collocations.phrase: demonstrate the appropriate level of technical competence
collocations.translation: 课文原句：展示出相应水平的专业技术能力
collocations.example: Leon graduated after demonstrating technical competence. 利昂在展示出相应的技术能力后毕业了。

collocations.phrase: gain a high level of competence in ...
collocations.translation: 【课件】在……方面获得很高的能力
collocations.example: I have gained a high level of competence in English. 我的英语已达到很高水平。
He is a man of integrity and high professional competence. 他正直而且业务能力很强。
Reading widely builds linguistic competence. 广泛阅读能培养语言能力。

collocations.phrase: have the competence to do sth
collocations.example: She has the competence to run the project. 她有能力管理这个项目。

collocations.translation: 【课件】在/超出某人的权限（能力范围）之内/外
collocations.example: It is not within my competence to make such judgements. 做这种判断不在我的权限之内。

synonyms.example: He has the ability to learn fast.
synonyms.usage: ability 最常用，可数，常接 to do；competence 较正式、通常不可数，指达到标准的胜任力，搭配 competence in sth / the competence to do sth。

synonyms.example: The company has the capability to expand.
synonyms.usage: capability 侧重潜在的、可开发的能力（capability of doing / to do）；competence 侧重经训练后达标的实际胜任水平。

synonyms.example: He is competent to carry out the work. = He is equal to the work.
synonyms.usage: 【课件】be equal to + n./doing 胜任……；对应 be competent at sth / be competent to do sth，注意 equal to 后接名词或动名词，competent to 后接动词原形。

advancedExpressions.expression: be competent at sth = be equal to sth = have the competence to do sth = be capable of doing sth
advancedExpressions.example: He is competent at his work. = He is equal to his work.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析(并列复合句)
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 "Leon graduated after demonstrating the appropriate level of understanding and technical competence, and he now anticipates a long and happy career as an electrician."：并列连词 and 连接两个完整分句构成并列句；前一分句内 after demonstrating... 为介词+动名词作时间状语。
advancedExpressions.example: 分析长难句先找并列连词(and/but/or/so)切分分句，再在各分句内找主谓宾。

advancedExpressions.expression: compete 竞争 → competition/competitor/competitive；competent 胜任 → competence/incompetence/competently
advancedExpressions.example: 词形相近但'比赛'与'胜任'两条词义线不同，考试常考 competitive 与 competent 的选择。

classPractice.question: I have gained a high level of competence ________ English.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；competence in sth 在……方面的能力。

classPractice.question: He was dismissed for ______________. 他因不称职被解雇。
classPractice.note: 课件原题；介词 for 后用名词，incompetence 无能、不称职。

classPractice.question: It is not ___________________ to make such judgements. 做这种判断不在我的权限之内。
classPractice.note: 课件原题；熟词僻义：competence 权限，职权范围。

classPractice.question: He is very ____________ ________ his work. 他很胜任他的工作。（= He is equal to his work.）
classPractice.note: 课件原题；be competent at sth = be equal to sth 胜任。

classPractice.question: He is ____________________________ the work. 他有能力开展这项工作。
classPractice.note: 课件原题；be competent to do sth 有能力做某事。

classPractice.question: Leon graduated after demonstrating the appropriate level of understanding and technical competence, ________ he now anticipates a long and happy career as an electrician.（课文原句）
classPractice.note: 本单元语法'长难句分析'：两个完整分句之间需并列连词 and 连接构成并列句。

translation: n. 娱乐，消遣
original_sentence: Not only is it recreation, but it also lights a lamp in the mind, bettering our understanding of the world around us.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （读作 /ˌriːkriːˈeɪʃn/，常写作 re-creation）再创造，重现
uncommonMeanings.example: The film is a faithful re-creation of life in the 1950s. 这部电影忠实再现了20世纪50年代的生活。

wordForms.noun: recreation 娱乐，消遣
wordForms.adjective: recreational 娱乐的，消遣的
wordForms.other: 构词法：re-（再）+ create（创造）+ -ion → 本义"重新创造（精力）"引申为"娱乐"。注意发音区分：recreation（娱乐）/ˌrekriˈeɪʃn/，re-creation（再创造）/ˌriːkriːˈeɪʃn/。作"娱乐"讲通常不可数。

collocations.translation: 它不仅是一种消遣……（课文原句，not only 置句首引起部分倒装）
collocations.example: Not only is it recreation, but it also lights a lamp in the mind. 读书不仅是消遣，还点亮心灵之灯。
He plays the guitar purely for recreation. 他弹吉他纯粹是为了消遣。

collocations.translation: 一种娱乐方式/娱乐来源
collocations.example: Reading is a popular form of recreation. 阅读是一种大众化的娱乐方式。
The park offers various recreational activities. 这个公园提供多种娱乐活动。

synonyms.example: The hotel provides live entertainment every night. 这家酒店每晚都有现场娱乐表演。
synonyms.usage: entertainment 侧重"由别人提供给你看/听"的娱乐节目；recreation 侧重"自己主动参与"的休闲活动（运动、阅读等）。两者都常作不可数名词。

synonyms.example: Fishing is his favourite pastime. 钓鱼是他最喜欢的消遣。
synonyms.usage: pastime 是可数名词，指某项具体的消遣活动，常与 favourite/popular 连用；recreation 多为不可数的抽象概念。

synonyms.example: The children were watching TV for amusement. 孩子们看电视取乐。
synonyms.usage: amusement 侧重"逗乐、好笑"的感受（to one's amusement 使某人好笑的是）；recreation 侧重放松身心的休闲活动，不含"好笑"义。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（并列句+倒装+分词状语）
advancedExpressions.expression: Not only is it recreation, but it also lights a lamp in the mind, bettering our understanding of the world around us.
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句结构：not only... but also... 连接并列句；not only 置于句首时前一分句部分倒装（is it recreation）；bettering... 为现在分词短语作结果状语。仿写：Not only does reading relax us, but it also broadens our minds.

advancedExpressions.expression: recreation / entertainment / pastime / amusement / leisure activities
advancedExpressions.example: In his leisure time, he enjoys various forms of recreation. 闲暇时他喜欢多种消遣方式。

classPractice.question: Reading is not just a form of __________ (recreate); it also enriches the mind.
classPractice.note: 介词 of 后接名词；recreate 的名词形式为 recreation。

classPractice.question: __________ __________ __________ recreation, but it also lights a lamp in the mind.（它不仅是消遣）
classPractice.note: 课文原句：not only 置于句首，其后分句要部分倒装。

classPractice.question: The community centre has excellent __________ (recreation) facilities such as pools and gyms.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 facilities 用形容词 recreational。

translation: n. 灯
original_sentence: Not only is it recreation, but it also lights a lamp in the mind, bettering our understanding of the world around us.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （发出特殊光线的）照射灯，理疗灯
uncommonMeanings.example: The doctor examined her skin under an ultraviolet lamp. 医生在紫外线灯下检查她的皮肤。

wordForms.noun: lamp 灯
wordForms.other: 常见复合词：lamppost 路灯柱，lampshade 灯罩，lamplight 灯光。可数名词，复数直接加 -s：lamps。

collocations.phrase: light a lamp in the mind
collocations.translation: 点亮心灵之灯（课文原句，比喻用法）
collocations.example: Reading lights a lamp in the mind. 阅读点亮心灵之灯。
She switched on the desk lamp to read. 她打开台灯看书。
The street lamps came on at dusk. 黄昏时路灯亮了。

collocations.phrase: by the light of a lamp
collocations.example: He wrote letters by the light of an oil lamp. 他借着油灯的光写信。

synonyms.example: Please turn off the lights before you leave. 离开前请关灯。
synonyms.usage: light 泛指一切"灯/光源"，最常用；lamp 特指"带灯座/灯罩的一盏灯"（台灯、油灯、路灯）。"开灯"日常多说 turn on the light。

synonyms.example: They hung red lanterns for the festival. 他们为节日挂起了红灯笼。
synonyms.usage: lantern 指有透明罩、可手提或悬挂的灯笼（如 the Lantern Festival 元宵节）；lamp 是一般的灯具。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（并列句+倒装）
advancedExpressions.expression: Not only is it recreation, but it also lights a lamp in the mind, bettering our understanding of the world around us.
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句：lights a lamp in the mind 是比喻（阅读启迪心智）；全句为 not only...but also... 并列句，前一分句部分倒装，bettering 为分词作结果状语。

advancedExpressions.expression: light a lamp in the mind / enlighten sb / open sb's mind / broaden one's horizons
advancedExpressions.example: A good book can open your mind and broaden your horizons. 一本好书能启迪心智、开阔眼界。

classPractice.question: 读书不仅是消遣，还能点亮心灵之灯。
classPractice.answer: Not only is reading recreation, but it also lights a lamp in the mind.
classPractice.note: 套用课文原句；not only 句首引起部分倒装。

classPractice.question: 用 lamp / lantern 填空：(1) He turned on the desk ______ to do his homework. (2) We admired the colourful ______ at the Lantern Festival.
classPractice.note: 台灯用 lamp；元宵节的灯笼用 lantern。

translation: adj. 随机的；辨认不出的；不合常理的
original_sentence: A recent survey on Chinese people’s reading habits, based on a random sample of more than 10,000 people from 30 cities across China, revealed that the Chinese spend a lot of time reading.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）奇怪的，不合常理的；莫名其妙的
uncommonMeanings.example: A random guy came up and started talking to me. 一个莫名其妙的家伙走过来和我搭话。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （仅用于短语 at random 中作名词）随机
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher picked students at random to answer. 老师随机点学生回答。

wordForms.noun: randomness 随机性
wordForms.adjective: random 随机的
wordForms.other: 注意：at random 中的 random 是名词，该用法仅限于此短语；"随机做某事"= do sth at random = do sth randomly。

collocations.example: The survey was based on a random sample of 10,000 people. 该调查基于一万人的随机样本。
We interviewed a random selection of teenagers. 我们随机采访了一些青少年。
Names were chosen at random from a list. 名字是从名单中随便点的。
The winning numbers are randomly selected by the computer. 中奖号码由电脑随机选出。
He typed a seemingly random sequence of numbers. 他输入了一串看似杂乱无章的数字。
The police carried out random checks on drivers. 警方对司机进行了抽查。

synonyms.example: He gave a casual glance at the newspaper. 他随意瞥了一眼报纸。
synonyms.usage: casual 指态度"随意、不用心"（casual clothes 便装，casual remark 随口的话）；random 指"无固定模式、碰运气式"的随机（random sample 随机样本）。random 多作定语或用于 at random。

synonyms.example: The decision seemed completely arbitrary. 这个决定似乎完全是武断的。
synonyms.usage: arbitrary 带贬义，指"不讲道理、凭个人意志"的任意；random 是中性词，指"无规律、随机"的，统计学中专用 random。

advancedExpressions.expression: at random / a random sample of / a random selection of / be randomly selected / a random check
advancedExpressions.example: Ten students were randomly selected — that is, chosen at random. 十名学生被随机选中。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（分词短语作定语+宾语从句）
advancedExpressions.expression: A recent survey on Chinese people's reading habits, based on a random sample of more than 10,000 people from 30 cities across China, revealed that the Chinese spend a lot of time reading.
advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句结构：主语 A recent survey（中心词）+ 过去分词短语 based on... 作后置定语（两个逗号间为插入成分）+ 谓语 revealed + that 引导的宾语从句。抓主干：A survey revealed that...

classPractice.question: We interviewed ____ ______ _______ ______ teenagers.（随机选择）
classPractice.note: a random selection of... 随机选择的……；random 作定语。

classPractice.question: The winning numbers are ___________ (random) selected by the computer.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 selected 用副词 randomly。

classPractice.question: a _________ (seem) random sequence of numbers
classPractice.note: 修饰形容词 random 用副词 seemingly（看似）。

classPractice.question: Names were chosen ____ random from a list. 名字是从名单中随便点的。
classPractice.note: 固定短语 at random 随便地、随机地；此处 random 为名词。

translation: n. 统计数字，统计资料

uncommonMeanings.meaning: statistics（作单数）统计学
uncommonMeanings.example: Statistics is a required course for economics majors. 统计学是经济学专业的必修课。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: become/be just a statistic（委婉语）沦为（伤亡等的）统计数字
uncommonMeanings.example: Drive carefully — don't become another road statistic. 小心驾驶——别成为又一个交通事故数字。

wordForms.noun: statistic（单个）统计数字；statistics 统计数据/统计学；statistician 统计学家
wordForms.adjective: statistical 统计的，统计学的
wordForms.other: 主谓一致贴士：statistics 表"统计学"（学科）谓语用单数；表"统计数据"谓语用复数。类似的还有 politics、economics、physics。

collocations.example: Statistics show that reading time is increasing. 统计数据表明阅读时间在增加。
According to official statistics, sales rose by 10%. 据官方统计，销量增长了10%。
Researchers gathered statistics from 30 cities. 研究人员从30个城市收集了统计数据。
The latest statistics on unemployment are worrying. 最新的失业统计数字令人担忧。

synonyms.example: The sales figures for May are excellent. 五月份的销售数字非常好。
synonyms.usage: figure 泛指"数字"，常用复数 figures 表各类数据；statistic(s) 特指"经统计得出"的数据，更正式，常与 show/reveal/suggest 连用。

synonyms.example: The data was/were collected over ten years. 这些数据是十年间收集的。
synonyms.usage: data 指未必经过统计处理的原始"数据/资料"（collect/analyse data）；statistics 是统计整理后的数字。data 谓语单复数皆可。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·据统计（读后续写/图表作文常用）
advancedExpressions.expression: Statistics show that... / According to statistics, ... / As is shown in the statistics, ... / The figures suggest that...
advancedExpressions.example: As is shown in the statistics, most students read on mobile devices. 统计数据显示，大多数学生用移动设备阅读。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主谓一致（-ics 类名词）
advancedExpressions.expression: Statistics is... (统计学) vs. Statistics are... (统计数据)
advancedExpressions.example: Statistics is his favourite subject, and the statistics in his paper are reliable. 统计学是他最喜欢的科目，而他论文中的数据是可靠的。

classPractice.question: __________ (statistic) show that the Chinese spend a lot of time reading.
classPractice.note: 表"统计数据"用复数 statistics，与谓语 show 一致。

classPractice.question: Statistics ______ (be) a branch of mathematics, but these statistics ______ (be) out of date.
classPractice.note: 前者指"统计学"（学科名，谓语用单数）；后者指"统计数据"（谓语用复数）。

classPractice.question: 根据最新统计数据，超过一半的青少年每天阅读。
classPractice.answer: According to the latest statistics, more than half of teenagers read every day.
classPractice.note: according to statistics 据统计。

translation: n. 平板电脑；药片

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （刻字的）碑，匾，牌位
uncommonMeanings.example: A memorial tablet was set up in his honour. 人们为纪念他立了一块碑。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英）一块（肥皂等）
uncommonMeanings.example: She bought a tablet of soap. 她买了一块肥皂。

wordForms.noun: tablet 平板电脑；药片；碑
wordForms.other: 构词法：源自拉丁语 tabula（板）+ 指小后缀 -et（小的），即"小板子"——由此引申出"药片（小圆板）、石碑（刻字板）、平板电脑（板状电脑）"三义。tablet computer 的简称即 tablet。

collocations.translation: 在平板电脑上阅读/记笔记
collocations.example: Many students take notes on a tablet in class. 许多学生上课用平板电脑记笔记。
Take two tablets with water after meals. 饭后用水送服两片。
She was prescribed sleeping tablets. 医生给她开了安眠药。
The laws were carved on stone tablets. 法律条文刻在石碑上。

synonyms.example: He swallowed the pill without water. 他没用水就把药丸吞了下去。
synonyms.usage: pill 泛指各种"药丸/药片"，最口语化；tablet 特指压制成的"药片"，稍正式（用于说明书）；capsule 指"胶囊"。三者都与 take 搭配。

synonyms.example: She writes her essays on a laptop. 她用笔记本电脑写文章。
synonyms.usage: laptop 指带键盘的笔记本电脑；tablet 指触屏平板电脑（如 iPad）。都是可数名词，常与 on 连用：on a laptop/tablet。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·电子阅读设备
advancedExpressions.expression: read on a tablet / on a mobile phone / on an e-reader / read e-books / digital reading
advancedExpressions.example: Digital reading on tablets and phones is replacing paper books for many. 对许多人来说，用平板和手机进行数字阅读正在取代纸质书。

advancedExpressions.expression: tablet（小板→药片/平板）/ booklet 小册子 / leaflet 传单 / packet 小包
advancedExpressions.example: The nurse handed me a leaflet and a packet of tablets. 护士递给我一张说明单和一小包药片。

classPractice.question: 用 tablet / pill / capsule 填空：(1) Reading on a ______ is convenient for commuters. (2) The medicine comes in ______ form — take two a day.
classPractice.note: (1) 平板电脑；(2) 药片，说明书语体中多用 tablet。

classPractice.question: 如今许多人更喜欢在平板电脑上看书，而不是读纸质书。
classPractice.answer: Nowadays many people prefer to read on tablets rather than read paper books.
classPractice.note: prefer to do... rather than do...；on a tablet 在平板上。

translation: n. 文凭，结业证书；证明，证明书
original_sentence: I held my certificate against my breast and smiled at the camera.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （读 /səˈtɪfɪkeɪt/，多用过去分词 certificated）发合格证书给
uncommonMeanings.example: She is a certificated teacher of English. 她是一名持证英语教师。

wordForms.noun: certificate 证书；certification 证明，认证
wordForms.verb: certify 证明，证实；发证书给
wordForms.adjective: certified 被证明的，有合格证书的（a certified doctor 持证医生）
wordForms.other: 构词法：cert-（确定，如 certain）+ -ify（动词后缀）→ certify 证明；certificate 作名词读 /səˈtɪfɪkət/，作动词读 /səˈtɪfɪkeɪt/，注意词尾发音变化。

collocations.phrase: hold one's certificate against one's breast
collocations.translation: 把证书抱在胸前（课文原句）
collocations.example: I held my certificate against my breast and smiled. 我把证书抱在胸前，露出了微笑。
The principal presented each graduate a certificate. 校长给每位毕业生颁发了证书。
She obtained a certificate in computer science. 她获得了计算机科学证书。
You need your birth certificate to apply for a passport. 申请护照需要出生证明。
He holds a certificate in first aid. 他持有急救证书。

synonyms.example: He was awarded a diploma in engineering. 他获得了工程学文凭。
synonyms.usage: diploma 特指完成学业课程后获得的"文凭"；certificate 范围更广，既指结业证书，也指出生证明等各类"证明书"。两者都与 award/receive 搭配。

synonyms.example: Teaching qualifications are required for this post. 该职位需要教师资格。
synonyms.usage: qualification 抽象地指"资格/资历"（常用复数）；certificate 是证明资格的那张"纸/证书"。have the qualifications for... 具备……的资格。

advancedExpressions.expression: certificate 结业证书/证明 · diploma 文凭 · degree 学位 · qualification 资格 · licence 执照
advancedExpressions.example: After the course she received a certificate, and two years later a bachelor's degree. 课程结束后她拿到结业证书，两年后又获学士学位。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·毕业领证场景（读后续写素材）
advancedExpressions.expression: hold the certificate against one's breast / smile at the camera / be awarded a certificate / at the graduation ceremony
advancedExpressions.example: At the ceremony, she held her certificate against her breast, tears of joy in her eyes. 典礼上她把证书抱在胸前，眼中含着喜悦的泪水。

classPractice.question: Only a __________ (certify) doctor is allowed to perform the operation.
classPractice.note: 修饰 doctor 用形容词 certified（有合格证书的）。

classPractice.question: 我把证书抱在胸前，对着镜头微笑。I __________ my certificate __________ my breast and smiled at the camera.
classPractice.note: 课文原句：hold sth against... 把某物贴/抱在……上。

classPractice.question: 完成该课程后，你将获得一张急救证书。
classPractice.answer: After completing the course, you will receive/obtain a certificate in first aid.
classPractice.note: receive/obtain a certificate in... 获得……证书。

translation: n. 胸部，胸脯
original_sentence: I held my certificate against my breast and smiled at the camera.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 胸部，胸脯（身体部位，常指胸的前部）
uncommonMeanings.example: I held my certificate against my breast.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （女性的）乳房
uncommonMeanings.example: The mother is breastfeeding her baby. （对应动词 breastfeed）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （禽类的）胸脯肉
uncommonMeanings.example: Would you like breast or leg? 你要胸脯肉还是腿肉？

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文学）内心，心怀
uncommonMeanings.example: A feeling of pride swelled in his breast. 一股自豪感在他心中油然而生。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义·文学）登上（山顶）；（胸部）迎着，冲过
uncommonMeanings.example: As we breasted the hill, we saw the town below. 我们登上山顶，看见了山下的小镇。

wordForms.noun: breast 胸部，胸脯（复数 breasts）
wordForms.verb: breastfeed 母乳喂养（breastfeed—breastfed—breastfed）
wordForms.other: 合成词：breaststroke 蛙泳、breast pocket 胸袋；发音贴士：/brest/ 中 ea 读 /e/，同 bread、health、breath

idioms.idiom: make a clean breast of sth
idioms.example: He decided to make a clean breast of his mistakes. 他决定坦白自己的错误。

collocations.translation: 把某物抱在胸前（课文原句）
collocations.example: I held my certificate against my breast and smiled at the camera. 我把证书抱在胸前，对着镜头微笑。
He kept the letter in his breast pocket. 他把信放在胸前口袋里。
I bought some chicken breast for dinner. 我买了些鸡胸肉当晚餐。
Regular checks help detect breast cancer early. 定期检查有助于及早发现乳腺癌。

synonyms.example: He folded his arms across his chest. 他双臂交叉抱在胸前。
synonyms.usage: chest 指男女通用的"胸膛/胸腔"，医学与身体部位描述常用（a chest X-ray 胸透）；breast 多指女性乳房、禽类胸脯肉，或文学化的"胸前/内心"。课文"抱在胸前"两词皆可：against one's breast/chest。

advancedExpressions.expression: against one's breast 抱在胸前 / across one's chest 交叉在胸前 / chin up 抬起下巴 / shoulders back 挺直肩膀
advancedExpressions.example: He held the trophy against his breast, chin up and shoulders back.

advancedExpressions.expression: breast + stroke → breaststroke 蛙泳；breast + feed → breastfeed 母乳喂养；breast + pocket → breast pocket 胸袋
advancedExpressions.example: She swims breaststroke every morning.

classPractice.question: 我把证书抱在胸前，对着镜头微笑。 I held my certificate ______ ______ ______ and smiled at the camera.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回填；against 表"紧贴，倚着"

classPractice.question: He made a clean ______ (breast) of what he had done wrong.
classPractice.note: 习语 make a clean breast of sth 坦白交代，breast 用单数

classPractice.question: 选用 breast / chest 填空：The doctor asked him to have a ______ X-ray.
classPractice.note: 医学检查指"胸腔"用 chest（chest X-ray 胸透）；breast 多指乳房或文学化的"胸前"

translation: n. 幕，帷幕；窗帘；帘，幔；覆盖物
original_sentence: Before I knew it, the ceremony was over and the curtain had come down on my university life.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 窗帘；帘，幔（"窗帘"义常用复数 the curtains）
uncommonMeanings.example: She drew the curtains to keep out the light.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （舞台的）幕，帷幕
uncommonMeanings.example: The curtain rises and the play begins.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （喻）事情的结尾，落幕：the curtain comes down on sth
uncommonMeanings.example: The curtain had come down on my university life.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 幕状覆盖物
uncommonMeanings.example: A curtain of rain moved across the valley.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义）给……挂帘子；curtain off 用帘子隔开
uncommonMeanings.example: The bed was curtained off from the rest of the room. 床用帘子和房间其余部分隔开。

wordForms.noun: curtain 幕；窗帘（复数 curtains；"一副窗帘"两片，故"拉窗帘"多用复数 the curtains）
wordForms.verb: curtain vt. 给……装帘子；curtain off 用帘子隔开
wordForms.other: 发音贴士：/ˈkɜːtn/ 重音在第一音节，-tain 弱读为 /tn/（同 certain、mountain、Britain）

idioms.example: If the bank refuses the loan, it's curtains for the company. 如果银行拒绝贷款，公司就完了。

collocations.phrase: the curtain had come down on...
collocations.translation: ……已落下帷幕（课文原句，喻大学生活结束）
collocations.example: Before I knew it, the curtain had come down on my university life. 不知不觉，我的大学生活已落下帷幕。
The ceremony brought down the curtain on my university life. 典礼为我的大学生活画上了句号。
She drew the curtains and turned on the light. 她拉上窗帘，打开了灯。
He pulled back the curtains to let in the sunlight. 他拉开窗帘让阳光照进来。

collocations.phrase: wait for the curtain to rise
collocations.example: The audience was waiting for the curtain to rise. 观众正等着开幕。

collocations.translation: 雨幕/雾幔/烟幕（幕状覆盖物）
collocations.example: A curtain of mist hid the hills from view. 一层雾幔遮住了群山。

synonyms.example: A screen of trees hid the house from the road. 一排树屏把房子挡住了。
synonyms.usage: curtain 指布制的窗帘/舞台幕布，固定搭配 draw the curtains、the curtain rises/falls；screen 泛指起遮挡作用的屏障（屏风、树屏、纱窗），还可作动词"遮蔽；筛查"。喻"终结"只能用 curtain。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·curtain 开幕与落幕（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: the curtain rises 开幕 / the curtain comes down 落幕 / bring down the curtain on... 标志着……终结 / raise the curtain on... 揭开……的序幕
advancedExpressions.example: The signing ceremony raised the curtain on a new era of cooperation.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析(并列+主从复合)
advancedExpressions.expression: Before I knew it, the ceremony was over and the curtain had come down on my university life. —— 主干是 and 连接的并列句（the ceremony was over + the curtain had come down），Before I knew it 为时间状语从句；had come down 用过去完成时，表"在我意识到之前帷幕已落下"。
advancedExpressions.example: 仿写：Before I knew it, the holiday was over and a new term had begun.

advancedExpressions.expression: the curtain comes down on... = come to an end = draw to a close
advancedExpressions.example: My high school life is drawing to a close. 我的高中生活即将落幕。（毕业类作文点题句）

classPractice.question: There was ___________________________________. 落幕时响起了雷鸣般的掌声。
classPractice.answer: thunderous applause when the curtain came down
classPractice.note: the curtain comes down 落幕；when 引导时间状语从句

classPractice.question: 这场典礼为我的大学生活画上了句号（落下了帷幕）。
classPractice.answer: The ceremony brought down the curtain on my university life.
classPractice.note: 课件搭配 bring down the curtain on... 标志着……终结

classPractice.question: She drew the ______ (curtain) to keep out the afternoon sun.
classPractice.note: "拉窗帘"习惯用复数 the curtains（一副窗帘为两片）

translation: 转瞬间，立即
original_sentence: Four years had disappeared in a flash.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 闪光，闪耀
uncommonMeanings.example: A flash of lightning lit up the sky. 一道闪电照亮了天空。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （情绪、灵感的）突现，闪现
uncommonMeanings.example: She had a sudden flash of inspiration.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （相机的）闪光灯
uncommonMeanings.example: Don't use the flash in the museum. 博物馆里不要用闪光灯。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 闪光，闪耀；（眼睛）闪出（某种情绪）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her eyes flashed with anger.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （想法、神色）闪现，掠过
uncommonMeanings.example: A smile flashed across her face.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义）飞驰，疾驰而过
uncommonMeanings.example: The train flashed by at high speed. 火车飞驰而过。

wordForms.noun: flash 闪光；闪光灯（复数 flashes）
wordForms.verb: flash 闪光；闪现；飞驰
wordForms.adjective: flashy 浮华的，俗艳的
wordForms.other: 合成词：flashback n. 闪回，倒叙（电影/文学手法）；flashlight n. 手电筒；发音：flash /flæʃ/

idioms.example: His first novel proved to be a flash in the pan. 他的第一部小说被证明只是昙花一现。
Quick as a flash, she gave the answer. 她飞快地说出了答案。

collocations.example: Four years had disappeared in a flash. 四年时光转瞬即逝。

collocations.translation: 【课件】转瞬间，立即（very quickly and suddenly）
collocations.example: The weekend was over in a flash. 周末一晃就过去了。
A look of terror flashed across his face. 他脸上掠过惊恐的神色。

collocations.translation: 【课件】（想法）闪过脑海（= shoot/pass through one's mind）
collocations.example: A terrible thought flashed through my mind. 一个可怕的想法闪过我的脑海。
Her thoughts flashed back to the graduation day. 她的思绪闪回到毕业典礼那天。
It flashed on me that I had left my key at home. 我突然想起把钥匙落在家里了。
Her eyes flashed with anger. 她眼中闪出怒火。
In a flash of inspiration, he found the answer. 灵光一闪，他找到了答案。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 紧的，牢固的；（衣、鞋）紧身的

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义）（钱）拮据的；（人）吝啬的
uncommonMeanings.example: Money was tight. / He's tight with his money.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （时间、日程）排得紧的，紧凑的

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （关系）亲密的，紧密的

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 严格的，严密的

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义）（比赛）势均力敌的，比分接近的
uncommonMeanings.example: It was a tight game right to the end. 比赛到最后都难分胜负。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （喉咙、胸口）发紧的；（表情）绷紧的
uncommonMeanings.example: Her throat felt tight. / a tight smile

wordForms.adjective: tight 紧的；拮据的；严格的（比较级 tighter，最高级 tightest）
wordForms.adverb: tight / tightly 紧紧地（tight 作副词只放动词后：hold tight, shut tight, sleep tight；tightly 位置灵活）
wordForms.verb: tighten 收紧；加强（tighten control 加强控制；tighten one's belt 勒紧裤腰带）

collocations.example: I had to hold on tight to my suitcase. 我不得不紧紧抓住手提箱。

The girl's dress is a tight fit. 那位姑娘的连衣裙刚好合身。

"I'm sorry," she said, with a tight smile. "对不起，"她勉强笑着说。
Her throat felt tight, just looking at her baby. 只是看着孩子，她的喉咙就发紧了。
His fists were clenched tight. 他的双拳紧紧攥着。
Good night, sleep tight! 晚安，睡个好觉！
We have a tight schedule this week. 我们这周日程很紧。

synonyms.example: Keep a firm hold on the rope. 牢牢抓住绳子。
synonyms.usage: tight 强调"绷紧、勒紧、不松动"（物理上的紧：a tight knot），引申义多（拮据/紧凑/势均力敌）；firm 强调"稳固、坚定"（a firm grip / a firm decision）。作副词时 tight 直接放动词后（hold tight），firm 一般不作副词。

translation: adj. & vi. adj. 明白事理的，成熟的 vi. 成熟，长成；有判断力
original_sentence: Did this new phase of my life mean that I was now mature enough to be entirely responsible for my own successes and failures?

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 明白事理的，成熟的
uncommonMeanings.example: She's very mature for her age.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 深思熟虑的（固定搭配 on mature reflection/consideration）
uncommonMeanings.example: On mature consideration, we changed the plan.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义）（酒、奶酪等）酿熟的，陈年的
uncommonMeanings.example: This cheese has a mature flavour. 这种奶酪味道醇厚。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义）a mature student（英）成人大学生（尤指较大年龄入学者，本单元主题"终身学习"相关）
uncommonMeanings.example: As a mature student, he went back to university at forty.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 成熟，长成；有判断力
uncommonMeanings.example: He has matured a lot since entering college.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义·金融）（票据、保单等）到期
uncommonMeanings.example: The insurance policy matures after twenty years. 这份保单二十年后到期。

wordForms.adjective: mature 成熟的（反义词 immature 不成熟的）
wordForms.verb: mature 成熟；（技术）趋于完善；（金融）到期
wordForms.noun: maturity 成熟；成熟期（reach maturity 达到成熟；immaturity 不成熟）
wordForms.other: 构词法：否定前缀 im-（用于 m/p/b 前）+ mature → immature，同类 impossible、impatient、imbalance；发音贴士：/məˈtʃʊə(r)/ 重音在第二音节

collocations.phrase: be mature enough to do sth
collocations.translation: 足够成熟去做某事（课文原句）

Technology in this field has matured considerably over the last decade. 这一领域的技术经过过去十年的发展已相当完善。

synonyms.example: She has two grown-up children. 她有两个已成年的孩子。
synonyms.usage: mature 强调心智成熟、明白事理，可修饰人/技术/酒类，可被 very 等程度副词修饰，且可作动词（mature into）；grown-up 侧重"已长大成人"，多作定语或表语；adult 是中性词"成年的"，多作定语（adult education 成人教育）。

The star's wedding turned into a media circus. 明星的婚礼变成了媒体的狂欢闹剧。

collocations.phrase: run away to join the circus
collocations.translation: 离家出走去加入马戏团
collocations.example: As a boy, he dreamed of running away to join the circus. 小时候他梦想离家去加入马戏团。
The circus performers amazed the audience. 马戏演员令观众惊叹。

synonyms.example: The station was in chaos after the storm. 暴风雨后车站一片混乱。
synonyms.usage: chaos 不可数，直述「混乱状态」，常用 in chaos；circus 表混乱是可数的比喻用法，常带 a：a circus / such a circus，语气带调侃「闹剧」色彩。

synonyms.example: There was a commotion outside the classroom. 教室外一阵喧闹。
synonyms.usage: commotion 指短暂的喧闹骚动，常用 there be a commotion；circus 强调场面像马戏团般乱哄哄、持续热闹，多作表语：be a (real) circus。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·wonder if 引导的宾语从句（长难句分析）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文句：I wondered if the first day of school was always such a circus. 主句 I wondered + if 引导的宾语从句（if=whether「是否」）；从句用陈述语序，时态与主句 wondered 保持过去范畴（was）。
advancedExpressions.example: She wondered if college life was really that busy. 她想知道大学生活是否真的那么忙。

advancedExpressions.expression: circus 马戏团（圆形场地）、circle 圆圈、circuit 环形线路/电路、circular 圆形的、circulate 循环流通、circumstance 环境（circum-围绕+stance 站）
advancedExpressions.example: Blood circulates around the body. 血液在体内循环。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「乱哄哄场面」表达
advancedExpressions.expression: be such a circus 乱得像马戏团；be in chaos 一片混乱；be in a mess 乱七八糟；chaotic adj. 混乱的
advancedExpressions.example: The airport was in chaos—it was a real circus. 机场一片混乱——简直乱成一团。

classPractice.question: 我想知道开学第一天是否总是这样乱哄哄的。
classPractice.answer: I wondered if/whether the first day of school was always such a circus.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；wonder if/whether + 陈述语序宾语从句，注意时态呼应用 was。

classPractice.question: ① The clown has worked in a ______ for ten years. ② The students sat in a ______ around the teacher. ③ There must be a break in the electrical ______.
classPractice.answer: ① circus ② circle ③ circuit
classPractice.note: 三词同根 circ-（圆）：circus 马戏团、circle 圆圈、circuit 电路/环形线路。

classPractice.question: The famous singer's arrival at the airport turned into a media ______ (circus), with hundreds of reporters pushing forward.
classPractice.note: a media circus 固定表达「媒体闹剧」；单数，前有冠词 a。

translation: n. 文章，短文
original_sentence: Unsurprisingly, it wasn’t a very good essay.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （学生的）作文，课程论文；（作家的）随笔，散文
uncommonMeanings.example: Bacon's essays are widely read. 培根的随笔广为传读。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 尝试，企图（an essay in/at sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: His first essay in politics ended in failure. 他在政界的首次尝试以失败告终。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 尝试，试图（essay to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: She essayed a smile despite her nervousness. 尽管紧张，她还是试着挤出一个微笑。

wordForms.noun: essay 文章，短文；essayist 散文家，随笔作家
wordForms.verb: essay 尝试（文学用语，少用）
wordForms.other: 名词重音在第一音节 /ˈeseɪ/，动词义重音在第二音节 /eˈseɪ/；词源：法语 essayer「尝试」→ 散文本是「尝试性的写作」

collocations.translation: 一篇很好的文章（课文原句）
collocations.example: Unsurprisingly, it wasn't a very good essay. 不出所料，那不是一篇好文章。

collocations.translation: 一篇关于几何的3000词文章（课文原句）
collocations.example: He was asked to write a 3,000-word essay on geometry. 他被要求写一篇3000词的几何论文。

collocations.translation: 写一篇关于某话题的文章
collocations.example: Write an essay on lifelong learning. 写一篇关于终身学习的文章。
You must hand in your essay by Friday. 你必须在周五前交文章。
The exam has two essay questions. 这次考试有两道论述题。

synonyms.example: The teacher asked us to write a composition about our hometown. 老师让我们写一篇关于家乡的作文。
synonyms.usage: composition 多指中小学生的命题作文；essay 覆盖面更广，从学生作文到大学课程论文、作家随笔都可用。二者都是可数名词。

synonyms.example: She wrote an article for the school magazine. 她为校刊写了一篇文章。
synonyms.usage: article 指发表在报纸、杂志、网站上的文章，读者是公众；essay 多为交给老师的作业或个人随笔。搭配：an article in the newspaper / an essay on a topic。

synonyms.example: He published a paper on climate change. 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的论文。
synonyms.usage: paper 指学术论文（研究性、可发表）或考卷；essay 一般是课程写作作业。大学里 essay 是常见作业形式，paper 更正式、更学术。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·数词-名词复合形容词（长难句中的定语）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文词块 a 3,000-word essay：「数词-名词」用连字符连接构成复合形容词作定语，中间的名词必须用单数：a 3,000-word essay（不是 words）、a five-year-old boy、a two-hour exam。
advancedExpressions.example: She gave a ten-minute speech on college life. 她做了一个10分钟的关于大学生活的演讲。

advancedExpressions.expression: be assigned an essay 被布置作文 → make an outline 列提纲 → draft 打草稿 → revise/polish 修改润色 → hand in/submit 上交 → get feedback 得到反馈
advancedExpressions.example: After drafting the essay, I revised it twice before handing it in. 打完草稿后，我修改了两遍才上交。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「文章」家族辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: essay 短文/随笔/课程作文；article 报刊文章；composition 命题作文；paper 学术论文；passage 阅读语篇；thesis 学位论文
advancedExpressions.example: For this course you'll write three essays and one final paper. 这门课你要写三篇短文和一篇期末论文。

classPractice.question: It was a 3,000-______ (word) essay on geometry, and I wasn't even sure how to begin.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；「数词-名词」复合形容词作定语，名词用单数。

classPractice.question: 不出所料，那不是一篇很好的文章。______, it wasn't a ______ ______ ______.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；unsurprisingly 副词作评注性状语，位于句首。

classPractice.question: ① I read an interesting ______ in today's newspaper. ② Our professor assigned a 2,000-word ______ on lifelong learning. ③ The scientist published a ______ in the journal Nature.
classPractice.answer: ① article ② essay ③ paper
classPractice.note: article 报刊文章；essay 课程作文；paper 学术论文。

translation: n. 几何（学）；几何形状
original_sentence: It was a 3,000-word essay on geometry and I wasn’t even sure how to begin the first paragraph.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 几何学（数学分支，研究点、线、面、体）
uncommonMeanings.example: Geometry deals with lines, angles and shapes. 几何学研究线、角和形状。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （物体的）几何形状，几何构造（the geometry of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Engineers changed the geometry of the car to reduce wind resistance. 工程师改变了汽车的几何构造以减小风阻。

wordForms.noun: geometry 几何（学）
wordForms.adjective: geometric / geometrical 几何（学）的；几何图形的
wordForms.adverb: geometrically 按几何学地；呈几何形地
wordForms.other: 构词：geo-（土地）+ -metry（测量）→ 本义「测量土地」；同根词：geography 地理、geology 地质学、thermometer 温度计、symmetry 对称；重音在第二音节 /dʒiˈɒmətri/，注意不重读 geo-

collocations.translation: 一篇关于几何的文章（课文原句）
collocations.example: It was a 3,000-word essay on geometry. 那是一篇关于几何的3000词文章。
We began to study geometry in junior high. 我们初中开始学几何。
He solved the geometry problem in five minutes. 他五分钟就解出了那道几何题。
The geometry of the bridge is quite unusual. 这座桥的几何造型很不寻常。

synonyms.example: Geometry is an important branch of mathematics. 几何是数学的重要分支。
synonyms.usage: mathematics 是学科总称（形式复数、谓语用单数）；geometry 是其分支之一，同级的还有 algebra 代数、statistics 统计学。作学科名时都不可数、前面不加冠词：study geometry/mathematics。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·and 连接的并列句（本单元语法：长难句分析）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文句：It was a 3,000-word essay on geometry and I wasn't even sure how to begin the first paragraph. and 连接两个并列分句；第二个分句中 how to begin... 是「疑问词+不定式」结构，作 sure 之后的内容（相当于宾语从句 how I should begin...）。
advancedExpressions.example: The task was difficult, and I didn't know where to start. 任务很难，我不知道从哪儿开始。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·数学学科家族
advancedExpressions.expression: mathematics 数学 ⊃ geometry 几何、algebra 代数、statistics 统计学、calculus 微积分、arithmetic 算术（学科名均不可数，谓语用单数）
advancedExpressions.example: Statistics is my favourite branch of mathematics. 统计学是我最喜欢的数学分支。

advancedExpressions.expression: geometry 几何（测地）、symmetry 对称、thermometer 温度计、kilometer 千米、barometer 气压计；geo-「地」：geography 地理、geology 地质学
advancedExpressions.example: The design shows perfect symmetry. 这个设计展现出完美的对称。

classPractice.question: ______ (geometry) figures such as circles, squares and triangles are studied in geometry class.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 figures 用形容词；句首大写。

classPractice.question: 那是一篇关于几何的3000词文章，我甚至不知道如何开始写第一段。
classPractice.answer: It was a 3,000-word essay on geometry and I wasn't even sure how to begin the first paragraph.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；注意 3,000-word 复合形容词及 how to begin 疑问词+不定式。

classPractice.question: 几何是数学的一个重要分支。Geometry ______ an important branch of ______.
classPractice.note: 学科名 geometry 不可数，谓语用单数 is；mathematics 形式复数、意义单数。

translation: n. 段，段落
original_sentence: It was a 3,000-word essay on geometry and I wasn’t even sure how to begin the first paragraph.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文章的）段，段落
uncommonMeanings.example: Read the first paragraph carefully. 仔细阅读第一段。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （报纸上的）短讯，短评
uncommonMeanings.example: There was a paragraph about the accident in the local paper. 当地报纸上有一则关于事故的短讯。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 将（文章）分段
uncommonMeanings.example: The essay is poorly paragraphed. 这篇文章分段很糟糕。

wordForms.noun: paragraph 段落（书面缩写 para.，如 Para. 2）
wordForms.verb: paragraph 给……分段（少用）
wordForms.other: 构词：para-（在旁）+ graph（写）→ 原指写在旁边表示分段的记号；graph「写」家族：photograph 照片、autograph 亲笔签名、biography 传记、graph 图表；重音在第一音节 /ˈpærəɡrɑːf/

collocations.translation: 开始写第一段（课文原句）
collocations.example: I wasn't even sure how to begin the first paragraph. 我甚至不知道怎么开始写第一段。
The opening paragraph should catch the reader's attention. 开头段应抓住读者的注意力。

collocations.phrase: the topic sentence of a paragraph
collocations.example: Each paragraph needs a clear topic sentence. 每段都需要一个明确的主题句。

collocations.translation: 在最后一段／第二段（阅读理解高频）
collocations.example: What does the author suggest in the last paragraph? 作者在最后一段暗示了什么？
Divide your essay into five paragraphs. 把你的文章分成五段。

synonyms.example: The passage consists of five paragraphs. 这篇语篇由五个段落组成。
synonyms.usage: passage 指整篇阅读材料或从书中摘出的一段文字（可含多段）；paragraph 是文章内部以换行开始的一个自然段。考题里 the passage=全文，Paragraph 2=第二自然段。

synonyms.example: Turn to the section on grammar. 翻到语法那一章节。
synonyms.usage: section 比 paragraph 大，指书或文件按主题划分的「部分/章节」，可包含多个段落；paragraph 是最小的成段单位。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·阅读理解题干高频表达
advancedExpressions.expression: According to Paragraph 2 根据第二段；the underlined word in Paragraph 3 第三段中画线的词；the main idea of the last paragraph 最后一段的主旨；What can be inferred from Paragraph 4? 从第四段可以推断出什么？
advancedExpressions.example: According to Paragraph 2, why did the author stay up all night? 根据第二段，作者为什么熬了一整夜？

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·疑问词+不定式（长难句压缩）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文句 I wasn't even sure how to begin the first paragraph 中，how to begin... 是「疑问词+不定式」，相当于宾语从句 how I should begin the first paragraph，是长句压缩、简化的常见手段。
advancedExpressions.example: He didn't know what to write in the opening paragraph. 他不知道开头段该写什么。

advancedExpressions.expression: paragraph 段落、photograph 照片（光+写）、autograph 亲笔签名（自己+写）、biography 传记（生平+写）、calligraphy 书法
advancedExpressions.example: The fan asked the writer for an autograph. 粉丝向作家索要亲笔签名。

classPractice.question: ① The ______ consists of six ______s. ② The book has a special ______ on study skills.
classPractice.note: passage 整篇语篇＞section 章节＞paragraph 自然段。

classPractice.question: 我甚至不知道如何开始写第一段。I wasn't even sure ______ ______ ______ the first paragraph.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；「疑问词+不定式」= how I should begin。

classPractice.question: 每个段落都应当以一个清晰的主题句开头。
classPractice.answer: Each paragraph should begin with a clear topic sentence.
classPractice.note: each+单数名词，谓语单数；begin with 以……开头。

translation: n. 笔记本电脑，便携式电脑
original_sentence: As the deadline approached, I had to stay up all night working on my laptop to complete it.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 笔记本电脑（laptop computer 的简称；lap 膝 + top 上面 → 可放在膝上用的电脑）
uncommonMeanings.example: You can use your laptop anywhere on campus. 在校园里任何地方你都能用笔记本电脑。

uncommonMeanings.partOfSpeech: n.（相关词 lap 的本义，助记）
uncommonMeanings.meaning: lap 指人坐着时的大腿面：The cat sat on her lap. 由此合成 laptop（膝上电脑），与 desktop（桌面电脑，台式机）相对。
uncommonMeanings.example: A laptop is portable while a desktop stays on the desk. 笔记本电脑便携，而台式机固定在桌上。

wordForms.noun: laptop 笔记本电脑（复数 laptops）
wordForms.other: 合成词：lap（膝）+ top（上面）；对照词 desktop 台式机（desk+top）、palmtop 掌上电脑（palm+top）；重音在第一音节 /ˈlæptɒp/；写作中首次提到可用 a laptop (computer)，之后用 the laptop 或 it

collocations.phrase: stay up all night working on my laptop
collocations.translation: 通宵用笔记本电脑赶工（课文原句）
collocations.example: I had to stay up all night working on my laptop. 我不得不通宵用笔记本电脑赶工。

collocations.translation: 在笔记本电脑上工作／写东西
collocations.example: She was working on her laptop in the library. 她在图书馆用笔记本电脑工作。
Many college students take notes on their laptops. 许多大学生用笔记本电脑记笔记。
Remember to charge your laptop before class. 上课前记得给笔记本电脑充电。

collocations.translation: 一台笔记本电脑（完整说法）
collocations.example: He bought a new laptop computer for college. 他为上大学买了台新笔记本电脑。

synonyms.example: This notebook weighs only one kilogram. 这台笔记本电脑只有一公斤重。
synonyms.usage: notebook 作「笔记本电脑」讲时与 laptop 同义，但 notebook 也常指纸质笔记本，语境不清时用 laptop 更明确；二者都是可数名词。

synonyms.example: A desktop is usually more powerful than a laptop. 台式机通常比笔记本电脑性能更强。
synonyms.usage: desktop 与 laptop 是同构反义对照：desktop 放桌上、不便携；laptop 便携。desktop 另有「（电脑屏幕的）桌面」义：on the desktop 在桌面上。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·主从复合句+分词伴随+不定式目的（本单元语法：长难句分析）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文句：As the deadline approached, I had to stay up all night working on my laptop to complete it. 结构三层：① As 引导时间状语从句「随着截止日期临近」；② working on my laptop 现在分词短语作伴随状语；③ to complete it 不定式作目的状语。主干只是 I had to stay up all night。
advancedExpressions.example: As the exam approached, she stayed up late reviewing her notes to get a good grade. 随着考试临近，她熬夜复习笔记以取得好成绩。

advancedExpressions.expression: stay up all night 通宵不睡；work on sth 从事/赶做某事；meet the deadline 赶上截止期限；the deadline approaches 截止日期临近；pull an all-nighter（口）开夜车
advancedExpressions.example: To meet the deadline, he pulled an all-nighter. 为了赶上截止日期，他开了个通宵夜车。

advancedExpressions.expression: laptop 膝上电脑（笔记本）、desktop 桌面电脑（台式机）/电脑桌面、palmtop 掌上电脑、rooftop 屋顶、hilltop 山顶
advancedExpressions.example: They watched the sunset from the rooftop. 他们在屋顶上看日落。

classPractice.question: As the deadline approached, I had to stay up all night ______ (work) on my laptop to complete the essay.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；stay up all night 后接现在分词作伴随状语，逻辑主语 I 与 work 是主动关系。

classPractice.question: 随着截止日期临近，我不得不通宵用笔记本电脑工作来完成它。
classPractice.answer: As the deadline approached, I had to stay up all night working on my laptop to complete it.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；as 时间状语从句 + working 伴随状语 + to complete 目的状语。

classPractice.question: ① I carry my ______ to the library every day because it's light. ② The office computers are all ______s, fixed on the desks.
classPractice.note: laptop 便携（lap 膝上）；desktop 台式（desk 桌上）。

translation: adj. 头晕目眩的；使人眩晕的
original_sentence: The next day I felt dizzy and started coughing and sneezing.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 头晕目眩的（feel/get/go dizzy，作表语）
uncommonMeanings.example: Standing up too quickly made me go dizzy. 起身太快让我发晕。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （高度、速度等）使人眩晕的（作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: They looked down from a dizzy height. 他们从令人眩晕的高处往下看。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）轻浮的，傻乎乎的
uncommonMeanings.example: She plays a dizzy blonde in the film. 她在电影里演一个傻乎乎的金发女郎。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: the dizzy heights (of)（常作幽默用法）显赫的地位
uncommonMeanings.example: He rose to the dizzy heights of manager. 他升到了经理的"高位"。

wordForms.adjective: dizzy 头晕的（比较级 dizzier，最高级 dizziest）
wordForms.noun: dizziness 头晕，眩晕
wordForms.other: 构词：dizzy＋-ness→dizziness；重音 /ˈdɪzi/；表"感到头晕"用 feel/get/go dizzy，dizzy 作表语

collocations.translation: 感到头晕（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The next day I felt dizzy and started coughing and sneezing. 第二天我感到头晕，开始咳嗽、打喷嚏。

collocations.translation: （兴奋／成功得）晕头转向，飘飘然
collocations.example: She was dizzy with excitement at the news. 听到消息她兴奋得晕头转向。
The plane climbed to a dizzy height. 飞机爬升到令人眩晕的高度。
The spinning ride made the children dizzy. 旋转设施让孩子们头晕。

synonyms.example: I feel giddy when I look down. 往下看我就头晕。
synonyms.usage: giddy 与 dizzy 近义，多作表语（feel giddy）；giddy 更常表"兴奋得飘飘然"（giddy with excitement），dizzy 侧重生理上的天旋地转。

synonyms.example: She felt faint from hunger. 她饿得头晕眼花。
synonyms.usage: faint 程度更重，指"快要晕倒"，作表语（feel faint）；faint 还可作动词"晕倒"，dizzy 无动词用法（常用）。

advancedExpressions.expression: feel dizzy / feel giddy / feel light-headed / my head is spinning（swimming）
advancedExpressions.example: My head was spinning after the ride. 坐完那个项目我头晕目眩。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·并列谓语（长难句分析）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 felt dizzy and started...：and 连接两个并列谓语，共用主语 I；started 后又接并列动名词 coughing and sneezing
advancedExpressions.example: The next day I felt dizzy and started coughing and sneezing.

classPractice.question: The medicine may cause ______ (dizzy), so don't drive after taking it.

classPractice.question: 从山顶往下看，我感到一阵眩晕。 Looking down from the mountain top, I ______ ______.
classPractice.note: feel dizzy 感到头晕，dizzy 作表语；与课文原句同款表达。

classPractice.question: 第二天我感到头晕，开始咳嗽、打喷嚏。
classPractice.answer: The next day I felt dizzy and started coughing and sneezing.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；felt 与 started 为并列谓语。

translation: vi. & n. vi. 打喷嚏 n. 喷嚏，喷嚏声

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 打喷嚏（不及物，不接宾语）
uncommonMeanings.example: I've been sneezing all morning. 我一上午都在打喷嚏。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 喷嚏，喷嚏声（可数：a sneeze）
uncommonMeanings.example: A sudden sneeze broke the silence. 突然一声喷嚏打破了寂静。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: sneeze at 轻视，小看（多用于否定式 not to be sneezed at 不可小觑）
uncommonMeanings.example: A 10% discount is not to be sneezed at. 九折优惠不可小觑。

wordForms.noun: sneeze 喷嚏（可数：a sneeze / two sneezes）
wordForms.verb: sneeze（sneezed, sneezed）打喷嚏
wordForms.other: 名动同形；同类拟声身体动作词多名动同形：cough 咳嗽、sniff 抽鼻子、yawn 打哈欠、hiccup 打嗝

idioms.translation: 不可小觑，值得重视（非正式）
idioms.example: An extra 2,000 yuan a month is not to be sneezed at. 每月多两千元可不是小数目。

collocations.translation: 开始咳嗽、打喷嚏（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I felt dizzy and started coughing and sneezing. 我感到头晕，开始咳嗽、打喷嚏。
He sneezed loudly during the meeting. 会上他大声打了个喷嚏。

collocations.phrase: cover your mouth when you sneeze
collocations.example: Please cover your mouth when you sneeze. 打喷嚏时请捂住嘴。

collocations.translation: 打个（响亮的）喷嚏（n. 用法）
collocations.example: She gave a loud sneeze. 她打了个响亮的喷嚏。
Pepper always makes me sneeze. 胡椒粉总让我打喷嚏。

synonyms.example: He has been coughing all night. 他咳了一整夜。
synonyms.usage: cough 与 sneeze 都是名动同形的不及物动词，感冒语境常并列（coughing and sneezing）；cough 指咳嗽，sneeze 指打喷嚏，不可混用。

advancedExpressions.expression: feel dizzy 头晕 / cough and sneeze 咳嗽打喷嚏 / have a runny nose 流鼻涕 / run a fever 发烧 / catch a cold 感冒
advancedExpressions.example: She caught a cold and kept sneezing. 她感冒了，不停打喷嚏。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·并列结构（长难句分析）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 started coughing and sneezing：and 连接两个动名词，同作 started 的宾语
advancedExpressions.example: The next day I felt dizzy and started coughing and sneezing.

classPractice.question: The dust in the old room set everyone ______ (sneeze).
classPractice.note: set sb doing sth 使某人（不由自主地）做某事。

classPractice.question: 这样的加薪机会不可小觑。 Such a pay rise is ______ ______ ______ ______ at.
classPractice.note: not to be sneezed at 不可小觑（熟词僻义：sneeze at 轻视）。

classPractice.question: 第二天我感到头晕，开始咳嗽、打喷嚏。
classPractice.answer: The next day I felt dizzy and started coughing and sneezing.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；start doing sth，两个动名词并列。

translation: n. & vt. n. 参考；提到；推荐信 vt. 查阅，参考
original_sentence: As soon as I received the next assignment, I headed straight for the library to find the reference books I needed for my research, and then created an outline followed by a draft.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 提及，谈及（＝mention sth/sb）：make/contain (no) reference to
uncommonMeanings.example: He made no reference to his illness. 他没有提及自己的病。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 查阅，参考：for (easy/future) reference
uncommonMeanings.example: Keep the receipt for future reference. 保留收据以备日后查用。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: [C] 推荐信（a letter of reference）；推荐人（英式亦称 referee）
uncommonMeanings.example: My teacher agreed to act as my reference. 老师同意做我的推荐人。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 参考文献（条目）；编号（reference number）
uncommonMeanings.example: There are fifty references at the end of the paper. 论文末尾列了五十条参考文献。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 查阅，参考；给……附参考书目（课件例句）
uncommonMeanings.example: The article does not need to reference anything. 这篇文章不需要附任何参考书目。

wordForms.noun: reference 参考；提及；推荐信（推荐人也说 referee）
wordForms.verb: refer（referred, referring，注意双写 r）提到；查阅；refer to...as... 把……称作
wordForms.adjective: referential 参考的，指涉的（学术用词）
wordForms.other: 构词：refer＋-ence→reference（同类：prefer→preference, differ→difference）；重音在第一音节 /ˈrefrəns/；"工具书"须说 a reference book

collocations.translation: 查找参考书（课文原句词块；reference book 工具书、参考书）
collocations.example: I headed for the library to find the reference books I needed. 我直奔图书馆找我需要的参考书。
The article made no reference to previous research on the subject. 文章没有提及关于该主题的先前研究。
The book is organized alphabetically for easy reference. 该书按字母顺序编排，便于查阅。
I am writing with reference to your article on salaries for scientists. 我就您那篇关于科学家薪酬的文章致信。
Could you write me a letter of reference? 您能给我写封推荐信吗？
Add a list of references at the end of your paper. 在论文末尾附上参考书目。
Please quote your reference number when calling. 来电时请报出您的编号。

synonyms.example: He made no mention of her work. 他没有提到她的工作。
synonyms.usage: make mention of＝make reference to；mention 可直接作及物动词（mention sth/sb），更口语；reference 表"提及"是名词，须搭配 make/contain reference to，更正式。

synonyms.example: Consult a dictionary if necessary. 必要时查词典。
synonyms.usage: consult a dictionary/map ＝ refer to...；表"查阅"时 consult 及物、更常用；reference 作动词多见于学术写作，指引用、标注文献。

advancedExpressions.expression: make (no) reference to 提及 / for easy (future) reference 以便查阅 / in (with) reference to 关于（正式）/ a letter of reference 推荐信 / a list of references 参考书目
advancedExpressions.example: There is no direct reference to it in the article. 文章中没有直接提及它。

advancedExpressions.expression: refer→reference；prefer→preference；differ→difference；occur→occurrence（双写 r）
advancedExpressions.example: 动词＋-ence 构成抽象名词，重音多前移。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句分析（课文原句）
advancedExpressions.expression: As soon as I received the next assignment, I headed straight for the library to find the reference books (that) I needed for my research, and then created an outline followed by a draft.——as soon as 时间状语从句＋并列谓语 headed...and created＋省略 that 的定语从句修饰 books＋过去分词短语 followed by a draft 作后置定语
advancedExpressions.example: 主干：I headed for the library and then created an outline.

classPractice.question: ______________________________ (没有直接提及) previous research on the subject in this article.
classPractice.answer: There is no direct reference to
classPractice.note: 课件原题；there be 句型＋no direct reference to，对应 make no reference to 的名词表达。

classPractice.question: I am writing ______ reference to your article on salaries for scientists.
classPractice.note: in/with reference to 关于……（正式书信用语，课件短语）。

classPractice.question: 这本书按字母顺序编排，以便查阅。
classPractice.answer: The book is organized alphabetically for easy reference.
classPractice.note: 课件例句；for easy/future reference 以便（日后）查阅。

classPractice.question: 他请我给他写一封推荐信。 He asked me to write him ______ ______ ______ ______.
classPractice.note: a letter of reference 推荐信；推荐人＝referee。

translation: n. & vt. n. 草稿，草案，草图 vt. 起草，草拟
original_sentence: As soon as I received the next assignment, I headed straight for the library to find the reference books I needed for my research, and then created an outline followed by a draft.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 汇票：a banker's draft 银行汇票
uncommonMeanings.example: Payment was made by banker's draft. 付款用的是银行汇票。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (the draft)（美）征兵，征募
uncommonMeanings.example: He avoided the draft in the 1960s. 他在20世纪60年代逃过了征兵。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （美式拼写，英式拼 draught）穿堂风；draft beer 生啤
uncommonMeanings.example: There's a cold draft from the window. 窗户透进一股冷风。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 选派，抽调：draft sb in/into
uncommonMeanings.example: Extra police were drafted in to control the crowd. 增派了警力来控制人群。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （美）征募……入伍；（职业体育）选中（新秀）
uncommonMeanings.example: He was drafted into the army at 18. 他18岁应征入伍。

wordForms.noun: draft 草稿，草案；汇票；（美）征兵；穿堂风
wordForms.verb: draft 起草；选派；（美）征募
wordForms.adjective: draft（名词作定语）草拟的：a draft plan 计划草案
wordForms.other: 英式英语中"穿堂风／生啤"义拼作 draught，发音同 /drɑːft/；drafting 起草（工作）；名动同形

collocations.phrase: create an outline followed by a draft
collocations.translation: 先列提纲，再写草稿（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I created an outline followed by a draft. 我先列了提纲，接着写出草稿。
The first draft was full of mistakes. 初稿错误百出。
Write a rough draft before the final version. 定稿前先打个草稿。
The committee drafted a new plan. 委员会起草了一份新计划。

collocations.translation: 协议草案／提案草案（draft 作定语）
collocations.example: They discussed the draft agreement. 他们讨论了协议草案。

synonyms.example: Make an outline before you write. 动笔前先列提纲。
synonyms.usage: outline 是要点式框架，draft 是已成文的初稿；课文写作流程：outline（提纲）→draft（草稿）→polish（润色）。

synonyms.example: They drew up a contract. 他们拟了一份合同。
synonyms.usage: draw up＝draft（vt.），后接 plan/contract/list 等；draw up 是短语动词，宾语为代词时须放中间（draw it up）。

advancedExpressions.expression: make/create an outline 列提纲 → write the first draft 写初稿 → revise/edit 修改 → polish 润色 → the final draft 定稿
advancedExpressions.example: After polishing, the final draft was ready. 润色之后，定稿完成了。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·过去分词作后置定语（长难句分析）
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 an outline followed by a draft：followed by... 过去分词短语作后置定语，表"先……随后是……"
advancedExpressions.example: a speech followed by a discussion 演讲之后接着讨论

classPractice.question: I created an outline ______ (follow) by a draft.
classPractice.note: outline 与 follow 是被动关系，过去分词短语作后置定语（课文原句）。

classPractice.question: 请在周五前起草一份新合同。 Please ______ ______ a new contract before Friday.
classPractice.note: draft vt.＝draw up 起草、拟订（两空可填 draw up，一空作 draft 亦可）。

classPractice.question: 他文章的初稿还需要润色。
classPractice.answer: The first draft of his essay still needs polishing.
classPractice.note: the first draft 初稿；need doing＝need to be done。

translation: vt. & vi. 修改，润饰；擦光，磨光 n. 抛光，上光；完美，娴熟，精湛

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 修改，润饰（文章、讲稿、表演等）
uncommonMeanings.example: She polished her speech before the contest. 比赛前她润色了讲稿。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 擦光，磨光
uncommonMeanings.example: This floor polishes easily. 这种地板很容易擦亮。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 上光剂：shoe polish 鞋油；nail polish 指甲油
uncommonMeanings.example: Apply a little shoe polish. 抹一点鞋油。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 擦拭，抛光：give sth a polish
uncommonMeanings.example: Give the table a good polish. 把桌子好好擦一擦。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 优雅，完美，娴熟，精湛
uncommonMeanings.example: His writing lacks polish. 他的文笔欠火候。

wordForms.verb: polish 擦亮；润色
wordForms.noun: polish 上光剂；擦拭；娴熟
wordForms.adjective: polished 擦亮的；优美的，娴熟的（a polished performance 精湛的表演）
wordForms.other: 熟词提醒：大写 Polish /ˈpəʊlɪʃ/ 波兰的，波兰语——与 polish /ˈpɒlɪʃ/ 仅首字母大小写之别，发音不同

idioms.example: He polished off the pizza in five minutes. 他五分钟就把披萨吃光了。
I must polish up on my grammar. 我得把语法再练一练。

collocations.translation: 经过仔细的修改和润色（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: After careful editing and polishing, the essay was much better. 经过仔细修改润色，文章好多了。
Spend some time polishing your essay. 花点时间润色你的文章。
He polished his shoes until they shone. 他把鞋擦得锃亮。
I need to polish up my English before the interview. 面试前我得提高一下英语。

collocations.translation: 鞋油／指甲油（n. 上光剂）
collocations.example: She bought a bottle of nail polish. 她买了一瓶指甲油。

synonyms.example: Refine your argument before submitting. 提交前先打磨论证。
synonyms.usage: refine 侧重"去粗取精、逐步完善"，常接 method/theory/style；polish 侧重最后的润色使更完美，常接 essay/speech/performance，也可指擦亮实物。

synonyms.example: He shined his shoes before the interview. 面试前他把鞋擦亮了。
synonyms.usage: shine（此义过去式 shined）＝polish 表"擦亮"，较口语；polish 还有"润色文字"义，shine 没有。

advancedExpressions.expression: polish sth 擦亮；润色 / polish up (on) sth 提高，温习 / polish off 迅速吃完（干完）/ give sth a polish 擦一擦
advancedExpressions.example: Polish up your CV before applying. 申请前把简历润色一下。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·并列句（长难句分析·课文原句）
advancedExpressions.expression: After careful editing and polishing, the result was a much better essay than the last, and it was ready in my desk drawer days before the deadline.——介词短语作状语＋and 连接两个并列分句
advancedExpressions.example: 主干：the result was a better essay, and it was ready in my drawer.

classPractice.question: After careful editing and ______ (polish), the essay was much better than the last.
classPractice.note: 介词 after 后接动名词，与 editing 并列（课文原句）。

classPractice.question: 面试前我需要提高一下我的英语。 I need to ______ ______ my English before the interview.
classPractice.note: polish up 改进，提高（＝improve）。

classPractice.question: 用 polish / refine 的适当形式填空：He ______ his shoes; later he ______ his research method.
classPractice.note: polish 擦亮实物、润色文章；refine 改进方法、理论。

translation: n. 抽屉
original_sentence: After careful editing and polishing, the result was a much better essay than the last, and it was ready in my desk drawer days before the deadline.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （支票、汇票的）出票人（商务术语，源自 draw 的"开具"义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The drawer signs the cheque. 出票人在支票上签字。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: drawers（旧式用法）衬裤，内裤
uncommonMeanings.example: He wore long woollen drawers in winter. 冬天他穿羊毛长衬裤。

wordForms.noun: drawer 抽屉；drawing 绘画，图画
wordForms.verb: draw（drew, drawn）拉；画；吸引
wordForms.other: 构词：draw＋-er；发音贴士："抽屉"义常读作一个音节 /drɔː(r)/，与 draw 几乎同音，不读成 /ˈdrɔːə(r)/

collocations.translation: 在我的书桌抽屉里（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The essay was ready in my desk drawer days before the deadline. 截止日期前几天，文章就在我书桌抽屉里备好了。
She opened the drawer and took out a pen. 她拉开抽屉拿出一支笔。
The keys are in the top drawer. 钥匙在最上面的抽屉里。
There is a chest of drawers in the bedroom. 卧室里有一个五斗橱。

advancedExpressions.expression: draw→drawer（被"拉"出的东西→抽屉）；-er 不总表"人"：cooker 炊具、opener 开瓶器；表"人"另见 drawing 无"画家"义（画家＝artist）
advancedExpressions.example: a bottle opener 开瓶器

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·并列句＋比较级（长难句分析·课文原句）
advancedExpressions.expression: ...the result was a much better essay than the last, and it was ready in my desk drawer days before the deadline.——and 连接并列分句；much 修饰比较级 better；days before... 名词短语作时间状语，表"提前好几天"

classPractice.question: She keeps all the letters in the bottom ______ (draw) of her desk.
classPractice.note: draw＋-er→drawer 抽屉；注意拼写，勿漏字母 e。

classPractice.question: 截止日期前几天，文章就已放在我的书桌抽屉里准备好了。
classPractice.answer: The essay was ready in my desk drawer days before the deadline.
classPractice.note: 课文原句回译；days before... 表"提前好几天"。

translation: n. 幻灯片演示；提交，授予；展示会；演出

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （口头带幻灯片的）报告，演示，陈述（本课义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 颁发，授予
uncommonMeanings.example: The presentation of the prizes will begin at three. 颁奖三点开始。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 提交，出示

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 展示方式，外观呈现（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: In cooking, presentation is as important as taste. 烹饪中摆盘和味道一样重要。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 演出，上演

wordForms.noun: presentation 报告;颁发 / presenter 主持人;报告人 / presence 出席;存在 / present 礼物;现在
wordForms.verb: present /prɪˈzent/ 呈现;赠送;提出
wordForms.adjective: present /ˈpreznt/ 出席的;现在的 / presentable 像样的，拿得出手的

Good presentation skills are important at university. 良好的展示技能在大学里很重要。
Tickets are given on presentation of your student ID. 出示学生证即可领票。

synonyms.example: The president delivered a speech to the nation. 总统向全国发表演讲。
synonyms.usage: speech 指正式演讲，重在讲话本身；presentation 侧重借助 PPT 等材料的展示汇报，常与 give/make/deliver 搭配，后接 on/about+话题。

synonyms.example: The teacher gave a demonstration of the experiment. 老师演示了这个实验。
synonyms.usage: demonstration 指操作示范（demonstrate how to do sth）；presentation 指内容陈述展示。两者都可作 give 的宾语。

synonyms.example: He gave a talk on his trip to Tibet. 他作了一个关于西藏之行的讲座。
synonyms.usage: talk 较随意，give a talk on sth；presentation 更正式、常有幻灯片辅助，是大学课堂高频词。

advancedExpressions.expression: give/make/deliver a presentation on... / present sth to sb 向某人展示某物 / be present at... 出席
advancedExpressions.example: He presented his findings to the class in a presentation. 他在报告中向全班展示了他的发现。

advancedExpressions.expression: present(v.呈现)→presentation(n.报告)；present(adj.出席的)→presence(n.出席)；presenter(n.主持人)；presentable(adj.像样的)
advancedExpressions.example: Your presence at the presentation is requested. 敬请出席本次报告会。

advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 "Everyone would be assigned a specific task, and my role was usually to produce the presentation." and 连接两个并列分句；前一分句是 assign sb sth 的被动语态 be assigned sth；would 表过去反复发生的动作。
advancedExpressions.example: Everyone would be assigned a specific task, and my role was usually to produce the presentation.

classPractice.question: He gave a wonderful ________ (present) on Chinese culture at the conference.
classPractice.note: give a presentation on... 就……作报告；冠词 a 后接名词。

classPractice.question: 每个人都会被分配一项具体任务，而我的角色通常是制作演示文稿。Everyone would ________ ________ a specific task, and my role was usually to produce the presentation.
classPractice.note: assign sb sth 的被动式 be assigned sth；would 后接动词原形 be。课文原句。

classPractice.question: 用 presence / presentation / present 的适当形式填空：Your ________ at the graduation ceremony will be a great honour to us.
classPractice.note: presence 出席；presentation 报告；present n.礼物/adj.出席的。此处需名词'出席'。

translation: n. 自助餐厅，自助食堂
original_sentence: We would meet in the school cafeteria to bounce ideas off each other, and would laugh and argue and laugh some more as we learnt to work together as a team.

wordForms.noun: cafeteria 自助餐厅（复数 cafeterias）
wordForms.other: 外来词，源自西班牙语。注意与 café/cafe（咖啡馆，小餐馆）区分：cafeteria 指自助式食堂（自己取餐再付款）。发音五音节 /ˌkæfəˈtɪəriə/，重音在 -te-。

collocations.translation: 在学校自助餐厅碰面（课文原句）
collocations.example: We would meet in the school cafeteria to bounce ideas off each other. 我们常在学校食堂碰面交流想法。
Lunch is served in the staff cafeteria at noon. 中午员工食堂供应午餐。
Most students have lunch in the cafeteria. 大多数学生在食堂吃午饭。
The cafeteria food here is better than I expected. 这里的食堂饭菜比我预想的好。

synonyms.example: The workers eat in the factory canteen. 工人们在工厂食堂吃饭。
synonyms.usage: canteen 英式常用，指工厂/学校/部队的食堂；cafeteria 美式常用，强调自助取餐形式。高考两词都认，写作可互换。

synonyms.example: The college dining hall seats 500 students. 学院餐厅能容纳 500 名学生。
synonyms.usage: dining hall 指大而正式的就餐大厅（英美大学常用）；cafeteria 更口语、更强调自助形式。

advancedExpressions.expression: cafeteria 自助食堂 / canteen 单位食堂 / dining hall 就餐大厅 / restaurant 餐馆 / café 咖啡馆 / buffet 自助餐
advancedExpressions.example: We grabbed coffee at a café, then ate in the cafeteria. 我们在咖啡馆买了咖啡，然后去食堂吃饭。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句(并列+主从复合)
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 "We would meet in the school cafeteria to bounce ideas off each other, and would laugh and argue and laugh some more as we learnt to work together as a team." and 连接两个并列谓语 would meet.../would laugh...；as 引导时间状语从句'随着我们学会团队合作'；would do 表过去常常。
advancedExpressions.example: We would meet in the school cafeteria..., and would laugh and argue... as we learnt to work together as a team.

classPractice.question: 我们过去常在学校自助餐厅碰面，互相交流想法。We ________ ________ in the school ________ to bounce ideas off each other.
classPractice.note: would do 表过去反复的习惯动作（=used to do）。课文原句。

classPractice.question: 用 cafeteria / café / canteen 填空：Students line up with trays in the school ________ at noon.
classPractice.note: 端着托盘排队自助取餐→cafeteria；café 是喝咖啡的小馆；canteen 亦通但语境为美式学校自助食堂。

classPractice.question: 午餐时间学校食堂总是很拥挤。
classPractice.answer: The school cafeteria is always crowded at lunchtime.
classPractice.note: cafeteria 作主语；be crowded 拥挤。

translation: vt. & vi. & n. vt. （向某人）试探地透露（主意） vi. 跳动 n. 弹跳；活力
original_sentence: We would meet in the school cafeteria to bounce ideas off each other, and would laugh and argue and laugh some more as we learnt to work together as a team.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （向某人）试探地透露（主意），征求反馈（本课义）：bounce ideas off sb
uncommonMeanings.example: It was good to bounce ideas off another mind. 和别人交流想法真好。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （使）弹起，反弹；拍（球）
uncommonMeanings.example: The ball bounced twice before he caught it. 球弹了两下他才接住。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 蹦跳，颠跳
uncommonMeanings.example: The children bounced up and down with excitement. 孩子们兴奋得上蹿下跳。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 弹跳，反弹
uncommonMeanings.example: Catch the ball on the first bounce. 在球第一次弹起时接住它。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 活力，劲头
uncommonMeanings.example: Exercise gives me a new bounce in my step. 锻炼让我的步伐充满活力。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （支票）被拒付退回（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: His cheque bounced and the rent went unpaid. 他的支票被退回，房租没付成。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （电子邮件）被退回（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: My email to the professor bounced. 我发给教授的邮件被退回了。

wordForms.noun: bounce 弹跳;活力 / bouncer （酒吧、俱乐部的）保安
wordForms.verb: bounce（bounced, bounced, bouncing）
wordForms.adjective: bouncy 有弹性的;精力充沛的 / bouncing 健壮活泼的（a bouncing baby）
wordForms.other: 发音 /baʊns/，注意 ou 发 /aʊ/。名词动词同形。

collocations.translation: 互相交流试探想法（课文原句）
collocations.example: We would meet in the cafeteria to bounce ideas off each other. 我们常在食堂碰面互相交流想法。

collocations.phrase: bounce a ball against the wall
collocations.example: He bounced a ball against the wall for hours. 他对着墙拍了几个小时的球。
The kids bounced up and down on the sofa. 孩子们在沙发上蹦上蹦下。
Let's bounce a few ideas around. 我们交流一下看法吧。

collocations.translation: 【课件】重振旗鼓，恢复健康/信心（=recover）
collocations.example: With the problems resolved, the company managed to bounce back. 问题解决后公司重振旗鼓。
Try to catch the ball on the second bounce. 试着在球第二次弹起时接住它。
I feel like there's a new bounce in my step. 我觉得自己步伐里有了新活力。

synonyms.example: She bounded to her feet and waved happily. 她跳起来高兴地挥手。
synonyms.usage: bound 指大步跳跃前进（本单元 Reading 也讲：with one bound 一跳）；bounce 侧重'弹起、反复颠跳'或引申'交流想法'。两词都可作名词表'跳'。

synonyms.example: The ball rebounded off the wall. 球从墙上弹了回来。
synonyms.usage: rebound 强调碰到物体后弹回（rebound off/from sth），也喻'反弹回升'；bounce 泛指弹跳，口语更常用。

advancedExpressions.expression: bounce back 重振旗鼓，恢复 / bounce ideas off sb 向某人试探想法 / bounce ideas around 交流讨论想法 / bounce sth off sth 使从……弹开
advancedExpressions.example: He's had a lot of problems, but he always bounces back quickly. 他遇到很多问题，但总能很快恢复。

advancedExpressions.expression: bounce back = recover = get back on one's feet 重振旗鼓，恢复健康/信心
advancedExpressions.example: The team bounced back from two defeats to win the cup. 球队从两场失利中恢复过来赢得奖杯。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句(并列+主从复合)
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句中 and 连接并列谓语 would meet.../would laugh...；as 引导时间状语从句；课件练习 "With the problems resolved, the company managed to bounce back." 为 with 复合结构：problems 与 resolve 是被动关系，用过去分词 resolved。
advancedExpressions.example: With the problems resolved, the company managed to bounce back.

classPractice.question: With the problems ________ (resolve), the company managed to bounce back.
classPractice.note: with 复合结构：problems 与 resolve 为被动关系，用过去分词；bounce back 重振旗鼓。

classPractice.question: He's had a lot of problems, but he always seems to ________ ________ pretty quickly.
classPractice.note: bounce back = recover 重振旗鼓，恢复健康/信心。

classPractice.answer: Let's bounce a few ideas around.
classPractice.note: bounce ideas around 讨论、交流想法；对比 bounce ideas off sb 向某人试探想法。

translation: 向某人试探地透露主意
original_sentence: We would meet in the school cafeteria to bounce ideas off each other, and would laugh and argue and laugh some more as we learnt to work together as a team.

collocations.translation: 互相交流试探想法（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】试探着和别人讲自己的想法
collocations.example: Sometimes we bounce ideas off others to help clarify our thinking. 有时我们向别人试探想法以帮助理清思路。

collocations.translation: 【课件】交流一下看法（无特定对象时用 around）
collocations.example: Let's bounce a few ideas around. 我们交流一下看法吧。

synonyms.example: Students exchange ideas with each other in groups. 学生们分组互相交换意见。
synonyms.usage: bounce ideas off sb 强调把想法'抛'给对方听取反馈，off 后接人；exchange ideas with sb 强调双向交流，with 后接人。介词不能混用。

synonyms.example: We brainstormed solutions to the problem together. 我们一起为这个问题集思广益。
synonyms.usage: brainstorm 可及物（brainstorm ideas）或不及物，指集体快速想点子；bounce ideas off sb 更口语，强调借他人反馈理清思路。

advancedExpressions.expression: bounce ideas off sb / bounce ideas around / exchange ideas with sb / share ideas with sb / brainstorm (ideas) / compare notes with sb 交流看法
advancedExpressions.example: After class we compared notes and bounced ideas off each other. 课后我们交流笔记、互相碰撞想法。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句(并列+主从复合)
advancedExpressions.expression: 课文原句 "We would meet... to bounce ideas off each other, and would laugh and argue and laugh some more as we learnt to work together as a team." and 连接两个并列谓语；不定式 to bounce... 作目的状语；as 引导时间状语从句；would 表过去反复的动作。
advancedExpressions.example: We would meet in the school cafeteria to bounce ideas off each other, and would laugh and argue... as we learnt to work together as a team.

classPractice.question: 有时我们试探着和别人讲自己的想法，以帮助澄清我们的想法。Sometimes we ________ ideas ________ others to help clarify our thinking.
classPractice.note: bounce ideas off sb：off 后接人，表示把想法抛给对方听反馈。课件原句。

classPractice.note: exchange ideas with sb ≈ bounce ideas off sb，注意介词由 with 变 off。

classPractice.question: 我们过去常在学校食堂碰面，互相交流想法。

translation: n. 教授；讲师，教员
original_sentence: I remembered visiting my favourite professor, a tall gentleman with his beard and hair going grey, during his office hours for the first time.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （英）教授（大学最高职称）
uncommonMeanings.example: She holds the position of Professor of History. 她担任历史学教授。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （美，泛指）大学教师，讲师（不一定有教授职称）（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the US, students often call any college teacher "professor". 在美国，学生常称任何大学老师为 professor。

wordForms.noun: professor 教授 / profession 职业（尤指脑力职业）/ professorship 教授职位
wordForms.verb: profess 声称;公开表明（profess to be... 自称是……）
wordForms.adjective: professional 职业的，专业的 / professorial 教授(似)的
wordForms.other: 构词法：profess(声称)+-or(表'人'的后缀)→professor'公开讲授学问的人'。重音在第二音节 /prəˈfesə(r)/。头衔缩写 Prof.，如 Prof. Smith。

collocations.phrase: visit my favourite professor during his office hours
collocations.translation: 在答疑时间拜访我最喜欢的教授（课文原句）
collocations.example: I remembered visiting my favourite professor during his office hours. 我记得在答疑时间去拜访我最喜欢的教授。

collocations.phrase: a professor of physics / a physics professor
collocations.translation: 物理学教授（核心搭配：professor of+学科）
collocations.example: She is a professor of physics at Oxford. 她是牛津大学的物理学教授。
He was promoted to associate professor last year. 他去年升为副教授。
A visiting professor from Japan gave the lecture. 一位日本客座教授作了讲座。
Professor Li will answer your questions after class. 李教授课后回答你们的问题。

synonyms.example: She works as a lecturer in law at the university. 她在大学当法学讲师。
synonyms.usage: 英国高校职级：lecturer(讲师)→senior lecturer→professor(教授)；professor 是最高职称。两词都常接 in/of+学科。

synonyms.example: My English teacher encourages us to read widely. 我的英语老师鼓励我们广泛阅读。
synonyms.usage: teacher 泛指中小学教师；professor 专指大学教授（美式可泛指大学教师）。称呼语中 Professor 可直接+姓氏，teacher 不能这样用（不说 Teacher Wang，用 Mr/Ms Wang）。

advancedExpressions.expression: office hours 教师答疑时间 / tutor 导师 / lecture 讲座 / seminar 研讨课 / faculty 全体教师 / campus 校园
advancedExpressions.example: You can see the professor during his office hours. 你可以在答疑时间去见教授。

advancedExpressions.expression: profess→professor；类似：instruct→instructor 教员 / advise→advisor 顾问 / edit→editor 编辑 / invent→inventor 发明家
advancedExpressions.example: The professor is also the editor of an academic journal. 这位教授还是一份学术期刊的编辑。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·长难句(同位语+with复合结构)

advancedExpressions.example: I remembered visiting my favourite professor, a tall gentleman with his beard and hair going grey.

classPractice.question: I remembered ________ (visit) my favourite professor during his office hours for the first time.

classPractice.question: He is a ________ (profession) basketball player, and his uncle is a professor of law.
classPractice.note: 词族转换：profession n.职业→professional adj.职业的；professor 教授。

classPractice.question: 史密斯教授正在给一年级新生作一个关于终身学习的讲座。
classPractice.answer: Professor Smith is giving a lecture on lifelong learning to the freshmen.
classPractice.note: Professor+姓氏作头衔首字母大写；give a lecture on... 就……作讲座。

translation: n. 胡须，络腮胡子
